akhfash:12-12.t: He said ﴿وَأُمِرْتُ لأَنْ أَكُونَ﴾, i.e. and with that I was commanded.

akhfash:17-17.t: And He said ﴿وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱجْتَنَبُواْ ٱلطَّاغُوتَ أَن يَعْبُدُوهَا﴾ because ﴿الطاغوتَ﴾ has the meaning of a plural. He also said ﴿أَوْلِيَآؤُهُمُ ٱلطَّاغُوتُ﴾. If you wish, you make it a feminine singular.

akhfash:19-19.t: And He said ﴿أَفَأَنتَ تُنقِذُ مَن﴾, i.e. "would you then rescue him?"; He was satisfied by His word ﴿تُنقِذُ مَن فِي ٱلنَّارِ﴾ in place of this.

akhfash:22-22.t: And He said ﴿أَفَمَن شَرَحَ ٱللَّهُ صَدْرَهُ لِلإِسْلاَمِ فَهُوَ عَلَىٰ نُورٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِ﴾: He put His word ﴿فَوَيْلٌ لِّلْقَاسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُمْ﴾ in the place of the khabar (predicate).

akhfash:24-24.t: And He said ﴿أَفَمَن يَتَّقِي بِوَجْهِهِ﴾: no khabar (predicate) for this appears in the wording, but it is there in the meaning — and Allah knows best — as though it were "is one who shields himself with his face better, or one who does not shield himself?"

akhfash:28-28.t: And He said ﴿قُرْآناً عَرَبِيّاً غَيْرَ ذِي عِوَجٍ﴾ because His word ﴿وَلَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِي هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْآنِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍ﴾ is definite, so its khabar is accusative.

akhfash:33-33.t: And He said ﴿وَٱلَّذِي جَآءَ بِٱلصِّدْقِ﴾ and then said ﴿أُوْلَـٰئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ﴾: He made "الذي" (the one who) have the meaning of a plural, equivalent to ﴿مَنْ﴾.

akhfash:60-60.t: And He said ﴿وُجُوهُهُم مُّسْوَدَّةٌ﴾ and put it in the nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject). Some put it in the accusative, making it a badal (substitute). Likewise ﴿وَيَجْعَلَ ٱلْخَبِيثَ بَعْضَهُ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ﴾: he made it a badal for ﴿الخبيث﴾. Some read ﴿بَعْضُه على بَعْض﴾ in the nominative as a mubtadaʾ, or (because) he occupied the verb with the first (noun). Some read ﴿مُسْوادَّةٌ﴾, which is a dialect of the people of the Ḥijāz: they say "اِسْوادَّ وجهُهُ" (his face became black) and "اِحْمارَّ" (became red), making it of the pattern "اِفْعَالَّ", as you say of a grey horse "قدِ اشْهَابَّ" (it has become grey) [and of a blue-eyed one] "قدِ ازْرَاقَّ". Some said "اِفْعَالَّ" does not occur for something of a single colour, [and] it occurs only in the like of "الأشهب" (grey, a mixed colour), not in the like of "الأحمر" (red). They are two dialect forms.

akhfash:64-64.t: And He said ﴿أَفَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ تَأْمُرُونِّيۤ أَعْبُدُ﴾: He means "Is it other than Allah that I should worship, you command me?", as though He intended ilghāʾ (cancelling the operation of the verb) — and Allah knows best — just as you say "هَلْ ذَهَب فُلانٌ. تَدْرِي" (has so-and-so gone — do you know?), making it in the meaning of "do you not know".

akhfash:65-65.t: And He said ﴿وَلَقَدْ أُوْحِيَ إِلَيْكَ وَإِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكَ لَئِنْ أَشْرَكْتَ لَيَحْبَطَنَّ عَمَلُكَ﴾.

akhfash:67-67.t: And He said ﴿وَٱلأَرْضُ جَمِيعـاً قَبْضَـتُهُ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَامَةِ وَٱلسَّمَاوَاتُ مَطْوِيَّاتٌ بِيَمِينِهِ﴾: He means "in His power", like His word ﴿وَمَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُكُمْ﴾, i.e. what you had power over; possession does not belong to the right hand apart from the left and the rest of the body. As for His word ﴿قَبْضَـتُهُ﴾, it is like your saying to a man: "this is in your hand and in your grasp".

akhfash:73-73.t:
And He said ﴿حَتَّىٰ إِذَا جَآءُوهَا وَفُتِحَتْ أَبْوَابُهَا﴾: it is said that His word ﴿وَقَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَا﴾ has the meaning of ﴿قالَ لَهُمْ﴾, as though the wāw were dropped. Something has come in poetry in which the wāw seems to be redundant. The poet said [in the kāmil metre; this is poetic witness no. 105]:
فإذَا وذلِكَ يا كُبَيْشَةُ لَمْ يَكُنْ * إِلاَّ كَلَمَّةِ حَالِمٍ بِخَيالِ
(And then, that, O Kubaysha, was nothing but like the passing visit of a phantom to a dreamer.)
It seems that he means "فإِذَا ذلكَ لَمْ يكُنْ" (and then that was not). Some said: "He implied the khabar (i.e. the apodosis)", and implying the khabar is better in the verse too, and it occurs in speech.

akhfash:75-75.t: And He said ﴿وَتَرَى ٱلْمَلاَئِكَةَ حَآفِّينَ مِنْ حَوْلِ ٱلْعَرْشِ﴾: ﴿مِنْ﴾ was brought in here for emphasis — and Allah knows best — as in your saying "مَا جَاءَنِي من أَحَدٍ" (not anyone came to me). "الحافْينَ" is doubled because it is from "حَفَفْتُ" (I surrounded).

celaleyn:1-1.t: ﴿تَنْزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ﴾ the Quran; mubtadaʾ (subject) ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ its khabar (predicate) ﴿الْعَزِيزِ﴾ in His dominion ﴿الْحَكِيمِ﴾ in His making.

celaleyn:2-2.t: ﴿إِنَّا أَنْزَلْنَا إِلَيْكَ﴾ O Muḥammad ﴿الْكِتَابَ بِالْحَقِّ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) "أَنْزَلَ" ﴿فَاعْبُدِ اللَّهَ مُخْلِصًا لَهُ الدِّينَ﴾ from shirk (associating partners), i.e. affirming His oneness.

celaleyn:3-3.t: ﴿أَلَا لِلَّهِ الدِّينُ الْخَالِصُ﴾ no one other than Him deserves it. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾ the idols ﴿أَوْلِيَاءَ﴾ and they are the disbelievers of Mecca; they said: ﴿مَا نَعْبُدُهُمْ إِلَّا لِيُقَرِّبُونَا إِلَى اللَّهِ زُلْفَى﴾ nearness; a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the sense of "تَقْرِيبًا" ("bringing near") ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ﴾ and the Muslims ﴿فِيمَا هُمْ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ﴾ of the matter of religion, so He will admit the believers to Paradise and the disbelievers to the Fire. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي مَنْ هُوَ كَاذِبٌ﴾ in ascribing a child to Him ﴿كَفَّارٌ﴾ by his worshipping other than Allah.

celaleyn:4-4.t: ﴿لَوْ أَرَادَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا﴾ as they said, "The Most Merciful has taken a child" ﴿لَاصْطَفَى مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَاءُ﴾ and taken it as a child, other than those of whom they said that the angels are the daughters of Allah, that ʿUzayr is the son of Allah and that the Messiah is the son of Allah. ﴿سُبْحَانَهُ﴾ declaring Him transcendent above taking a child ﴿هُوَ اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ﴾ over His creation.

celaleyn:5-5.t: ﴿خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) "خَلَقَ" ﴿يُكَوِّرُ﴾ He makes enter ﴿اللَّيْلَ عَلَى النَّهَارِ﴾ so it increases ﴿وَيُكَوِّرُ النَّهَارَ﴾ He makes it enter ﴿عَلَى اللَّيْلِ﴾ so it increases ﴿وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ كُلٌّ يَجْرِي﴾ in its orbit ﴿لِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى﴾ until the Day of Resurrection. ﴿أَلَا هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ﴾ prevailing over His affair, taking vengeance on His enemies ﴿الْغَفَّارُ﴾ to His friends.

celaleyn:6-6.t: ﴿خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ نَفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ﴾ i.e. Ādam ﴿ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا﴾ Ḥawwāʾ ﴿وَأَنْزَلَ لَكُمْ مِنَ الْأَنْعَامِ﴾ camels, cattle and small livestock, sheep and goats ﴿ثَمَانِيَةَ أَزْوَاجٍ﴾ of each a pair, male and female, as is explained in Sūrat al-Anʿām ﴿يَخْلُقُكُمْ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ خَلْقًا مِنْ بَعْدِ خَلْقٍ﴾ i.e. as drops of sperm, then clinging clots, then lumps of flesh ﴿فِي ظُلُمَاتٍ ثَلَاثٍ﴾ they are the darkness of the belly, the darkness of the womb and the darkness of the placenta. ﴿ذَلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَأَنَّى تُصْرَفُونَ﴾ from His worship to the worship of another?

celaleyn:7-7.t: ﴿إِنْ تَكْفُرُوا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ عَنْكُمْ وَلَا يَرْضَى لِعِبَادِهِ الْكُفْرَ﴾ even if He wills it from some of them ﴿وَإِنْ تَشْكُرُوا﴾ Allah, and so believe ﴿يَرْضَهْ﴾ with sukūn on the hāʾ, and with ḍamma [يَرْضَهُ], with lengthening (ishbāʿ) and without it, i.e. [He will be pleased with] the gratitude ﴿لَكُمْ وَلَا تَزِرُ﴾ a soul ﴿وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ﴾ of a soul ﴿أُخْرَى﴾ i.e. it will not carry it. ﴿ثُمَّ إِلَى رَبِّكُمْ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَيُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ إِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ﴾ of what is in the hearts.

celaleyn:8-8.t: ﴿وَإِذَا مَسَّ الْإِنْسَانَ﴾ i.e. the disbeliever ﴿ضُرٌّ دَعَا رَبَّهُ﴾ he supplicates humbly ﴿مُنِيبًا﴾ turning back ﴿إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلَهُ نِعْمَةً﴾ He gives him a favour ﴿مِنْهُ نَسِيَ﴾ he abandons ﴿مَا كَانَ يَدْعُو﴾ he was supplicating humbly ﴿إِلَيْهِ مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ and that is Allah, so "مَا" is in the place of "مَنْ" ﴿وَجَعَلَ لِلَّهِ أَنْدَادًا﴾ partners ﴿لِيَضِلَّ﴾ with fatḥa on the yāʾ and with ḍamma [لِيُضِلَّ] ﴿عَنْ سَبِيلِهِ﴾ the religion of Islam. ﴿قُلْ تَمَتَّعْ بِكُفْرِكَ قَلِيلًا﴾ the rest of your term ﴿إِنَّكَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّارِ﴾

celaleyn:9-9.t: ﴿أَمَنْ﴾ with the mīm light [undoubled] ﴿هُوَ قَانِتٌ﴾ performing the duties of obedience ﴿آنَاءَ اللَّيْلِ﴾ its hours ﴿سَاجِدًا وَقَائِمًا﴾ in prayer ﴿يَحْذَرُ الْآخِرَةَ﴾ he fears its punishment ﴿وَيَرْجُوا رَحْمَةَ﴾ the Paradise ﴿رَبِّهِ﴾ like one who is disobedient, through disbelief or otherwise? In a reading [it is] [أَمْ مَنْ], so "أَمْ" has the meaning of "بَلْ" plus the hamza. ﴿قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِي الَّذِينَ يَعْلَمُونَ وَالَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ i.e. they are not equal, just as the knowledgeable and the ignorant are not equal. ﴿إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ﴾ take heed ﴿أُولُوا الْأَلْبَابِ﴾ the possessors of intellect.

celaleyn:10-10.t: ﴿قُلْ يَا عِبَادِ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا رَبَّكُمْ﴾ i.e. His punishment, by obeying Him. ﴿لِلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا فِي هَذِهِ الدُّنْيَا﴾ through obedience ﴿حَسَنَةٌ﴾ it is Paradise. ﴿وَأَرْضُ اللَّهِ وَاسِعَةٌ﴾ so emigrate to it from among the disbelievers and from witnessing abominations. ﴿إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى الصَّابِرُونَ﴾ on obedience and on what they are tried with ﴿أَجْرَهُمْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ﴾ without measure or scale.

celaleyn:11-11.t: ﴿قُلْ إِنِّي أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ اللَّهَ مُخْلِصًا لَهُ الدِّينَ﴾ from shirk (associating partners),

celaleyn:12-12.t: ﴿وَأُمِرْتُ لِأَنْ﴾ i.e. "بِأَنْ" ("to") ﴿أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ﴾ of this nation.

celaleyn:13-13.t: ﴿قُلْ إِنِّي أَخَافُ إِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّي عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here.]

celaleyn:14-14.t: ﴿قُلِ اللَّهَ أَعْبُدُ مُخْلِصًا لَهُ دِينِي﴾ from shirk (associating partners).

celaleyn:15-15.t: ﴿فَاعْبُدُوا مَا شِئْتُمْ مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾ other than Him. In it there is a threat to them and an announcement that they do not worship Allah the Exalted. ﴿قُلْ إِنَّ الْخَاسِرِينَ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوا أَنْفُسَهُمْ وَأَهْلِيهِمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَمَةِ﴾ by the souls being made to abide eternally in the Fire, and by their not reaching the ḥūr (maidens of Paradise) prepared for them in Paradise had they believed. ﴿أَلَا ذَلِكَ هُوَ الْخُسْرَانُ الْمُبِينُ﴾ the clear.

celaleyn:16-16.t: ﴿لَهُمْ مِنْ فَوْقِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ﴾ layers ﴿مِنَ النَّارِ وَمِنْ تَحْتِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ﴾ of fire. ﴿ذَلِكَ يُخَوِّفُ اللَّهُ بِهِ عِبَادَهُ﴾ i.e. the believers, so that they fear Him; as indicated by ﴿يَا عِبَادِ فَاتَّقُونِ﴾

celaleyn:17-17.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ اجْتَنَبُوا الطَّاغُوتَ﴾ the idols ﴿أَنْ يَعْبُدُوهَا وَأَنَابُوا﴾ turned ﴿إِلَى اللَّهِ لَهُمُ الْبُشْرَى﴾ of Paradise. ﴿فَبَشِّرْ عِبَادِ﴾

celaleyn:18-18.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ يَسْتَمِعُونَ الْقَوْلَ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ أَحْسَنَهُ﴾ which is what contains their welfare. ﴿أُولَئِكَ الَّذِينَ هَدَاهُمُ اللَّهُ وَأُولَئِكَ هُمْ أُولُوا الْأَلْبَابِ﴾ the possessors of intellect.

celaleyn:19-19.t: ﴿أَفَمَنْ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِ كَلِمَةُ الْعَذَابِ﴾ i.e. {لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ}, the ayah ﴿أَفَأَنْتَ تُنْقِذُ﴾ bring out ﴿مَنْ فِي النَّارِ﴾ the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); in it the overt noun has been put in the place of the pronoun, and the hamza is for denial (inkār). The meaning is: you are not able to guide him and so save him from the Fire.

celaleyn:20-20.t: ﴿لَكِنِ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا رَبَّهُمْ﴾ by obeying Him ﴿لَهُمْ غُرَفٌ مِنْ فَوْقِهَا غُرَفٌ مَبْنِيَّةٌ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ﴾ i.e. from beneath the upper and the lower rooms. ﴿وَعْدَ اللَّهِ﴾ accusative (manṣūb) by its implied (muqaddar) verb. ﴿لَا يُخْلِفُ اللَّهُ الْمِيعَادَ﴾ His promise.

celaleyn:21-21.t: ﴿أَلَمْ تَرَ﴾ know ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ أَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَسَلَكَهُ يَنَابِيعَ﴾ He made it enter places of springing ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُ بِهِ زَرْعًا مُخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَانُهُ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ﴾ dries up ﴿فَتَرَاهُ﴾ after the greenness, for example ﴿مُصْفَرًّا ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُ حُطَامًا﴾ crumbled fragments. ﴿إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لَذِكْرَى﴾ a reminder ﴿لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ﴾ who take heed by it, because it points to the oneness of Allah the Exalted and His power.

celaleyn:22-22.t: ﴿أَفَمَنْ شَرَحَ اللَّهُ صَدْرَهُ لِلْإِسْلَامِ﴾ and so he is guided ﴿فَهُوَ عَلَى نُورٍ مِنْ رَبِّهِ﴾ like one whose heart He has sealed? This is indicated by: ﴿فَوَيْلٌ﴾ a word of punishment ﴿لِلْقَاسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُمْ مِنْ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ﴾ i.e. against accepting the Quran ﴿أُولَئِكَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ﴾ clear.

celaleyn:23-23.t: ﴿اللَّهُ نَزَّلَ أَحْسَنَ الْحَدِيثِ كِتَابًا﴾ a badal (substitute) of "أَحْسَنَ", i.e. a Quran ﴿مُتَشَابِهًا﴾ i.e. part of it resembles other parts in composition and otherwise ﴿مَثَانِيَ﴾ in it the promise, the threat and other things are repeated ﴿تَقْشَعِرُّ مِنْهُ﴾ shiver at the mention of its threat ﴿جُلُودُ الَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ﴾ fear ﴿رَبَّهُمْ ثُمَّ تَلِينُ﴾ become at peace ﴿جُلُودُهُمْ وَقُلُوبُهُمْ إِلَى ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ﴾ i.e. at the mention of His promise. ﴿ذَلِكَ﴾ i.e. the Book ﴿هُدَى اللَّهِ يَهْدِي بِهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَمَنْ يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ هَادٍ﴾

celaleyn:24-24.t: ﴿أَفَمَنْ يَتَّقِي﴾ meets ﴿بِوَجْهِهِ سُوءَ الْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَمَةِ﴾ its severest, by being thrown into the Fire with his hands chained to his neck, like one who is safe from it by entering Paradise? ﴿وَقِيلَ لِلظَّالِمِينَ﴾ the disbelievers of Mecca ﴿ذُوقُوا مَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْسِبُونَ﴾ i.e. its recompense.

celaleyn:25-25.t: ﴿كَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ﴾ their messengers, about the coming of the punishment ﴿فَأَتَاهُمُ الْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ﴾ from a direction that did not occur to their minds.

celaleyn:26-26.t: ﴿فَأَذَاقَهُمُ اللَّهُ الْخِزْيَ﴾ abasement and humiliation, of transformation [into animals], killing and other things ﴿فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَلَعَذَابُ الْآخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ لَوْ كَانُوا﴾ i.e. those who denied ﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ its punishment, they would not have denied.

celaleyn:27-27.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا﴾ We have set forth ﴿لِلنَّاسِ فِي هَذَا الْقُرْآنِ مِنْ كُلِّ مَثَلٍ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ﴾ take admonition,

celaleyn:28-28.t: ﴿قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا﴾ an emphatic ḥāl (circumstantial; ḥāl muʾakkida) ﴿غَيْرَ ذِي عِوَجٍ﴾ i.e. ambiguity and inconsistency ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ﴾ disbelief.

celaleyn:29-29.t: ﴿ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ﴾ for the polytheist and the monotheist ﴿مَثَلًا رَجُلًا﴾ a badal (substitute) of "مَثَلًا" ﴿فِيهِ شُرَكَاءُ مُتَشَاكِسُونَ﴾ quarrelling, ill-natured ﴿وَرَجُلًا سَلَمًا﴾ wholly belonging ﴿لِرَجُلٍ هَلْ يَسْتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًا﴾ a tamyīz (specification), i.e. the slave of a group and the slave of one person are not equal: for when each of the first one's owners asks him for his service at the same time, he is confused as to which of them he should serve. This is a parable of the polytheist, and the second is a parable of the monotheist. ﴿الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ﴾ alone. ﴿بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ﴾ i.e. of the people of Mecca ﴿لَا يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ the punishment they are heading towards, and so they associate partners [with Allah].

celaleyn:30-30.t: ﴿إِنَّكَ﴾ an address to the Prophet ﷺ ﴿مَيِّتٌ وَإِنَّهُمْ مَيِّتُونَ﴾ you will die and they will die, so there is no rejoicing at [another's] death. It was revealed when they thought his death ﷺ was slow in coming.

celaleyn:31-31.t: ﴿ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ﴾ O people, regarding the wrongs between you ﴿يَوْمَ الْقِيَمَةِ عِنْدَ رَبِّكُمْ تَخْتَصِمُونَ﴾

celaleyn:32-32.t: ﴿فَمَنْ﴾ i.e. no one ﴿أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنْ كَذَبَ عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾ by ascribing a partner and a child to Him ﴿وَكَذَّبَ بِالصِّدْقِ﴾ the Quran ﴿إِذْ جَاءَهُ أَلَيْسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى﴾ a refuge ﴿لِلْكَافِرِينَ﴾ Yes indeed.

celaleyn:33-33.t: ﴿وَالَّذِي جَاءَ بِالصِّدْقِ﴾ he is the Prophet ﷺ ﴿وَصَدَّقَ بِهِ﴾ they are the believers; so "الَّذِي" has the meaning of "الَّذِينَ" ﴿أُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْمُتَّقُونَ﴾ shirk (associating partners).

celaleyn:34-34.t: ﴿لَهُمْ مَا يَشَاءُونَ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ ذَلِكَ جَزَاءُ الْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾ to themselves by their faith,

celaleyn:35-35.t: ﴿لِيُكَفِّرَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ أَسْوَأَ الَّذِي عَمِلُوا وَيَجْزِيَهُمْ أَجْرَهُمْ بِأَحْسَنِ الَّذِي كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ "أَسْوَأ" and "أَحْسَن" have the meaning of "the bad" and "the good".

celaleyn:36-36.t: ﴿أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِكَافٍ عَبْدَهُ﴾ i.e. the Prophet? Yes indeed. ﴿وَيُخَوِّفُونَكَ﴾ the address is to him ﴿بِالَّذِينَ مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾ the idols, i.e. [saying] that it will kill him or derange him. ﴿وَمَنْ يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ هَادٍ﴾

celaleyn:37-37.t: ﴿وَمَنْ يَهْدِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ مُضِلٍّ أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِعَزِيزٍ﴾ prevailing over His affair ﴿ذِي انْتِقَامٍ﴾ on His enemies? Yes indeed.

celaleyn:38-38.t: ﴿وَلَئِنْ﴾ the lām of an oath ﴿سَأَلْتَهُمْ مَنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّهُ قُلْ أَفَرَأَيْتُمْ مَا تَدْعُونَ﴾ you worship ﴿مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ﴾ i.e. the idols ﴿إِنْ أَرَادَنِيَ اللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ هَلْ هُنَّ كَاشِفَاتٌ ضُرَّهُ﴾ No. ﴿أَوْ أَرَادَنِي بِرَحْمَةٍ هَلْ هُنَّ مُمْسِكَاتٌ رَحْمَتَهُ﴾ No. In a reading, both are with iḍāfa (genitive construct) [كَاشِفَاتُ ضُرِّهِ مُمْسِكَاتُ رَحْمَتِهِ]. ﴿قُلْ حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ يَتَوَكَّلُ الْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ﴾ those who trust, trust.

celaleyn:39-39.t: ﴿قُلْ يَا قَوْمِ اعْمَلُوا عَلَى مَكَانَتِكُمْ﴾ your condition ﴿إِنِّي عَامِلٌ﴾ according to my condition ﴿فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ﴾

celaleyn:40-40.t: ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative [noun] (mawṣūla), the object of the knowing ﴿يَأْتِيهِ عَذَابٌ يُخْزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ﴾ descends ﴿عَلَيْهِ عَذَابٌ مُقِيمٌ﴾ lasting; it is the punishment of the Fire. And Allah did disgrace them at Badr.

celaleyn:41-41.t: ﴿إِنَّا أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ لِلنَّاسِ بِالْحَقِّ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) "أَنْزَلَ" ﴿فَمَنِ اهْتَدَى فَلِنَفْسِهِ﴾ is his guidance ﴿وَمَنْ ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَا وَمَا أَنْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِوَكِيلٍ﴾ so as to compel them to guidance.

celaleyn:42-42.t: ﴿اللَّهُ يَتَوَفَّى الْأَنْفُسَ حِينَ مَوْتِهَا وَ﴾ He takes ﴿الَّتِي لَمْ تَمُتْ فِي مَنَامِهَا﴾ i.e. He takes it at the time of sleep. ﴿فَيُمْسِكُ الَّتِي قَضَى عَلَيْهَا الْمَوْتَ وَيُرْسِلُ الْأُخْرَى إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى﴾ i.e. the time of its death. The one released is the soul of discernment (nafs al-tamyīz), without which the soul of life (nafs al-ḥayāt) remains, but not the reverse. ﴿إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ﴾ which has been mentioned ﴿لَآيَاتٍ﴾ indications ﴿لِقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ﴾ and so know that the One who is able to do that is able to resurrect. But Quraysh did not reflect on that.

celaleyn:43-43.t: ﴿أَمْ﴾ rather ﴿اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ﴾ i.e. the idols, as gods ﴿شُفَعَاءَ﴾ with Allah, as they claim? ﴿قُلْ﴾ to them: ﴿أَ﴾ will they intercede ﴿وَلَوْ كَانُوا لَا يَمْلِكُونَ شَيْئًا﴾ of intercession or anything else ﴿وَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ﴾ that you worship them, nor anything else? No.

celaleyn:44-44.t: ﴿قُلْ لِلَّهِ الشَّفَاعَةُ جَمِيعًا﴾ i.e. it belongs exclusively to Him, so no one intercedes except by His permission. ﴿لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ﴾

celaleyn:45-45.t: ﴿وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ﴾ i.e. without their gods ﴿اشْمَأَزَّتْ﴾ recoil and shrink ﴿قُلُوبُ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾ i.e. the idols ﴿إِذَا هُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ﴾

celaleyn:46-46.t: ﴿قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ﴾ meaning "O Allah" ﴿فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ their Originator ﴿عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ﴾ what is hidden and what is witnessed, ﴿أَنْتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِيمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ﴾ of the matter of religion; guide me to the truth concerning that in which they differed.

celaleyn:47-47.t: ﴿وَلَوْ أَنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا وَمِثْلَهُ مَعَهُ لَافْتَدَوْا بِهِ مِنْ سُوءِ الْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَمَةِ وَبَدَا﴾ appeared ﴿لَهُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يَكُونُوا يَحْتَسِبُونَ﴾ think.

celaleyn:48-48.t: ﴿وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُ مَا كَسَبُوا وَحَاقَ﴾ descended ﴿بِهِمْ مَا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ﴾ i.e. the punishment.

celaleyn:49-49.t: ﴿فَإِذَا مَسَّ الْإِنْسَانَ﴾ the genus ﴿ضُرٌّ دَعَانَا ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلْنَاهُ﴾ We give him ﴿نِعْمَةً﴾ a favour ﴿مِنَّا قَالَ إِنَّمَا أُوتِيتُهُ عَلَى عِلْمٍ﴾ from Allah that I am worthy of it. ﴿بَلْ هِيَ﴾ the saying ﴿فِتْنَةٌ﴾ an affliction with which the servant is tried ﴿وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ that the bestowal is a gradual leading on (istidrāj) and a test.

celaleyn:50-50.t: ﴿قَدْ قَالَهَا الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ﴾ of the nations, such as Qārūn and his people who were pleased with it ﴿فَمَا أَغْنَى عَنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ﴾

celaleyn:51-51.t: ﴿فَأَصَابَهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُ مَا كَسَبُوا﴾ i.e. their recompense. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا مِنْ هَؤُلَاءِ﴾ Quraysh ﴿سَيُصِيبُهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُ مَا كَسَبُوا وَمَا هُمْ بِمُعْجِزِينَ﴾ escaping Our punishment. So they suffered drought for seven years, then [provision] was made ample for them.

celaleyn:52-52.t: ﴿أَوَلَمْ يَعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ﴾ makes it ample ﴿لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ﴾ as a test ﴿وَيَقْدِرُ﴾ makes it scant for whom He wills, as a trial. ﴿إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ in it.

celaleyn:53-53.t: ﴿قُلْ يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنِطُوا﴾ with kasra on the nūn, and with fatḥa [تَقْنَطُوا], and it has been read with ḍamma: do not despair ﴿مِنْ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا﴾ for whoever repents from shirk (associating partners) ﴿إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ﴾

celaleyn:54-54.t: ﴿وَأَنِيبُوا﴾ return ﴿إِلَى رَبِّكُمْ وَأَسْلِمُوا﴾ make your deeds sincere ﴿لَهُ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَكُمُ الْعَذَابُ ثُمَّ لَا تُنْصَرُونَ﴾ by its being prevented, if they do not repent.

celaleyn:55-55.t: ﴿وَاتَّبِعُوا أَحْسَنَ مَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ﴾ it is the Quran ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَكُمُ الْعَذَابُ بَغْتَةً وَأَنْتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ﴾ before its coming, of its time. So hasten, before

celaleyn:56-56.t: ﴿أَنْ تَقُولَ نَفْسٌ يَا حَسْرَتَا﴾ its original form is "يَا حَسْرَتِي", i.e. "O my regret" ﴿عَلَى مَا فَرَّطْتُ فِي جَنْبِ اللَّهِ﴾ i.e. in obedience to Him ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ lightened from the heavy [إِنَّ], i.e. "and indeed I" ﴿كُنْتُ لَمِنَ السَّاخِرِينَ﴾ at His religion and His Book,

celaleyn:57-57.t: ﴿أَوْ تَقُولَ لَوْ أَنَّ اللَّهَ هَدَانِي﴾ to obedience, so that I was guided ﴿لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْمُتَّقِينَ﴾ His punishment,

celaleyn:58-58.t: ﴿أَوْ تَقُولَ حِينَ تَرَى الْعَذَابَ لَوْ أَنَّ لِي كَرَّةً﴾ a return to the world ﴿فَأَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾ the believers. Then it will be said to him on the part of Allah:

celaleyn:59-59.t: ﴿بَلَى قَدْ جَاءَتْكَ آيَاتِي﴾ the Quran, and it is the means of guidance ﴿فَكَذَّبْتَ بِهَا وَاسْتَكْبَرْتَ﴾ you were too proud to believe in them ﴿وَكُنْتَ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ﴾

celaleyn:60-60.t: ﴿وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَمَةِ تَرَى الَّذِينَ كَذَبُوا عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾ by ascribing a partner and a child to Him ﴿وُجُوهُهُمْ مُسْوَدَّةٌ أَلَيْسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى﴾ a refuge ﴿لِلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ﴾ against faith? Yes indeed.

celaleyn:61-61.t: ﴿وَيُنَجِّي اللَّهُ﴾ from Hell ﴿الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا﴾ shirk (associating partners) ﴿بِمَفَازَتِهِمْ﴾ by their place of triumph in Paradise, by their being placed in it ﴿لَا يَمَسُّهُمُ السُّوءُ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ﴾

celaleyn:62-62.t: ﴿اللَّهُ خَالِقُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَكِيلٌ﴾ disposing of it however He wills.

celaleyn:63-63.t: ﴿لَهُ مَقَالِيدُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ the keys of their treasuries, of rain, plants and other things. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ﴾ the Quran ﴿أُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ﴾ connected to His saying "وَيُنَجِّي اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا" etc., and what is between them is a parenthesis (iʿtirāḍ).

celaleyn:64-64.t: ﴿قُلْ أَفَغَيْرَ اللَّهِ تَأْمُرُونِي أَعْبُدُ أَيُّهَا الْجَاهِلُونَ﴾ "غَيْرَ" is accusative (manṣūb) by "أَعْبُدُ", which is governed by "تَأْمُرُونِي" with an implied "أَنْ"; with one nūn, and with two nūns, with assimilation (idghām) [تَأْمُرُونِّي] and with separation.

celaleyn:65-65.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ أُوحِيَ إِلَيْكَ وَإِلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ﴾ By Allah, ﴿لَئِنْ أَشْرَكْتَ﴾ O Muḥammad, hypothetically ﴿لَيَحْبَطَنَّ عَمَلُكَ وَلَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ﴾

celaleyn:66-66.t: ﴿بَلِ اللَّهَ﴾ alone ﴿فَاعْبُدْ وَكُنْ مِنَ الشَّاكِرِينَ﴾ of His favour upon you.

celaleyn:67-67.t: ﴿وَمَا قَدَرُوا اللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِ﴾ they did not know Him with the knowledge due to Him, or they did not magnify Him with the magnification due to Him, when they associated others with Him. ﴿وَالْأَرْضُ جَمِيعًا﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. the seven ﴿قَبْضَتُهُ﴾ i.e. grasped by Him, i.e. in His dominion and disposal ﴿يَوْمَ الْقِيَمَةِ وَالسَّمَاوَاتُ مَطْوِيَّاتٌ﴾ gathered ﴿بِيَمِينِهِ﴾ by His power. ﴿سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَى عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ﴾ with Him.

celaleyn:68-68.t: ﴿وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ﴾ the first blast ﴿فَصَعِقَ﴾ died ﴿مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا مَنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ﴾ of the ḥūr (maidens of Paradise), the youths and others. ﴿ثُمَّ نُفِخَ فِيهِ أُخْرَى فَإِذَا هُمْ﴾ all the dead creatures ﴿قِيَامٌ يَنْظُرُونَ﴾ waiting for what will be done with them.

celaleyn:69-69.t: ﴿وَأَشْرَقَتِ الْأَرْضُ﴾ shone ﴿بِنُورِ رَبِّهَا﴾ when Allah manifests Himself for the final judgement ﴿وَوُضِعَ الْكِتَابُ﴾ the record of deeds, for the reckoning ﴿وَجِيءَ بِالنَّبِيِّينَ وَالشُّهَدَاءِ﴾ i.e. Muḥammad ﷺ and his nation, who testify for the messengers that they conveyed [the message] ﴿وَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ﴾ i.e. justice ﴿وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ﴾ in anything.

celaleyn:70-70.t: ﴿وَوُفِّيَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَا عَمِلَتْ﴾ its recompense ﴿وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ﴾ i.e. knowing ﴿بِمَا يَفْعَلُونَ﴾ so He needs no witness.

celaleyn:71-71.t: ﴿وَسِيقَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾ with violence ﴿إِلَى جَهَنَّمَ زُمَرًا﴾ in separate groups ﴿حَتَّى إِذَا جَاءُوهَا فُتِحَتْ أَبْوَابُهَا﴾ the jawāb (answer) of "إِذَا" ﴿وَقَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَا أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ رُسُلٌ مِنْكُمْ يَتْلُونَ عَلَيْكُمْ آيَاتِ رَبِّكُمْ﴾ the Quran and others ﴿وَيُنْذِرُونَكُمْ لِقَاءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَذَا قَالُوا بَلَى وَلَكِنْ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَةُ الْعَذَابِ﴾ i.e. {لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ}, the ayah ﴿عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ﴾

celaleyn:72-72.t: ﴿قِيلَ ادْخُلُوا أَبْوَابَ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا﴾ with eternal abiding decreed for them ﴿فَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى﴾ the refuge ﴿الْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ﴾ is Hell.

celaleyn:73-73.t: ﴿وَسِيقَ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا رَبَّهُمْ﴾ gently ﴿إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ زُمَرًا حَتَّى إِذَا جَاءُوهَا وَفُتِحَتْ أَبْوَابُهَا﴾ the wāw in it is circumstantial (li-l-ḥāl), with "قَدْ" implied ﴿وَقَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَا سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكُمْ طِبْتُمْ﴾ in state ﴿فَادْخُلُوهَا خَالِدِينَ﴾ with eternal abiding in it decreed for them. The jawāb (answer) of "إِذَا" is implied (muqaddar), i.e. "they entered it". Their being driven and the opening of the gates before their arrival is an honour for them, while the driving of the disbelievers and the opening of the gates of Hell upon their arrival is so that its heat should remain for them, as a humiliation for them.

celaleyn:74-74.t: ﴿وَقَالُوا﴾ conjoined to the implied "دَخَلُوهَا" ﴿الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي صَدَقَنَا وَعْدَهُ﴾ of Paradise ﴿وَأَوْرَثَنَا الْأَرْضَ﴾ i.e. the land of Paradise ﴿نَتَبَوَّأُ﴾ we settle ﴿مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ حَيْثُ نَشَاءُ﴾ because in all of it no place is preferred over another. ﴿فَنِعْمَ أَجْرُ الْعَامِلِينَ﴾ is Paradise.

celaleyn:75-75.t: ﴿وَتَرَى الْمَلَائِكَةَ حَافِّينَ﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial) ﴿مِنْ حَوْلِ الْعَرْشِ﴾ from every side of it ﴿يُسَبِّحُونَ﴾ a ḥāl of the pronoun of "حَافِّينَ" ﴿بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ﴾ joining it with praise, saying "Glory be to Allah and with His praise" ﴿وَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ﴾ between all creatures ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ with justice, so the believers enter Paradise and the disbelievers the Fire. ﴿وَقِيلَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ﴾ The settling of the two groups is concluded with praise from the angels.

daas-irab:1-2.t: ﴿تَنْزِيلُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الْكِتابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is genitive by min; the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْعَزِيزِ﴾ badal (substitute). ﴿الْحَكِيمِ﴾ also a badal of the Name of Majesty. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْزَلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾ the two are attached to أنزلنا. ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ the two are attached to أنزلنا. ﴿فَاعْبُدِ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ of the implied condition), and an imperative verb, its agent latent (mustatir). ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مُخْلِصاً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿لَهُ﴾ the two are attached to مخلصا. ﴿الدِّينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi of the active participle.

daas-irab:3-3.t: ﴿أَلا﴾ a particle of alerting and opening (tanbīh wa-istiftāḥ). ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, genitive by the lām, a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿الدِّينُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الْخالِصُ﴾ a naʿt (adjective); the clause is initial, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and a mubtadaʾ. ﴿اتَّخَذُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the verbal clause is its ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أَوْلِياءَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿ما﴾ negative. ﴿نَعْبُدُهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its agent latent (mustatir), and the hāʾ is its object. ﴿أَلا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr) «[Translator's note: the word heading this item is printed in the source as أَلا; the Quranic word here is إِلَّا, which is what "particle of restriction" describes.]»; the clause is the khabar of الذين. ﴿لِيُقَرِّبُونا﴾ the lām is for causation (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an an implied after the lām of causation; the wāw is its agent and nā its object; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of genitive by the lām, and the two are attached to نعبدهم. ﴿إِلَى اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is genitive by ilā; the two are attached to يقربونا. ﴿زُلْفى﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿يَحْكُمُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, its agent latent. ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾ an adverb of place; the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿فِي ما﴾ the two are attached to يحكم. ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ the two are attached to يختلفون. ﴿يَخْتَلِفُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is its agent; the nominal clause is the ṣila, and the clause يختلفون is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يَهْدِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, its agent latent; the clause يهدي is the khabar of inna. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿هُوَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿كاذِبٌ﴾ first khabar. ﴿كَفَّارٌ﴾ second khabar; the nominal clause is the ṣila of مَن, and the clause of inna gives the reason for what precedes.

daas-irab:4-5.t: ﴿لَوْ أَرادَ﴾ law is a non-jussive conditional particle, and a past verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَنْ يَتَّخِذَ وَلَداً﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an, and ولدا is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the agent being latent (mustatir); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from an and what follows it is the object of أراد, and the clause أراد is initial, with no grammatical position. ﴿لَاصْطَفى﴾ the lām occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and a past verb, its agent latent. ﴿مِمَّا﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to اصطفى. ﴿يَخْلُقُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its agent latent. ﴿ما﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, its agent latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿سُبْحانَهُ﴾ a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb. ﴿هُوَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, khabar (predicate). ﴿الْواحِدُ﴾ second khabar. ﴿الْقَهَّارُ﴾ third khabar; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿خَلَقَ﴾ a past verb, its agent latent. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَالْأَرْضَ﴾ conjoined to السموات. ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿يُكَوِّرُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, its agent latent. ﴿اللَّيْلَ﴾ its object; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿عَلَى النَّهارِ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿وَيُكَوِّرُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, its agent latent. ﴿النَّهارِ﴾ its object. ﴿عَلَى اللَّيْلِ﴾ the two are attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَسَخَّرَ﴾ a past verb, its agent latent. ﴿الشَّمْسَ﴾ its object. ﴿وَالْقَمَرَ﴾ conjoined. ﴿كُلٌّ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَجْرِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿لِأَجَلٍ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿مُسَمًّى﴾ a naʿt (adjective). ﴿أَلا﴾ a particle of alerting (tanbīh). ﴿هُوَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفَّارُ﴾ two khabars; the nominal clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:6-6.t: ﴿خَلَقَكُمْ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنْ نَفْسٍ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿واحِدَةٍ﴾ a naʿt (adjective). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿جَعَلَ﴾ a past verb, its agent latent. ﴿مِنْها﴾ the two are attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿زَوْجَها﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَأَنْزَلَ﴾ a past verb, its agent latent. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿مِنَ الْأَنْعامِ﴾ the two are attached to أنزل. ﴿ثَمانِيَةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَزْواجٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَخْلُقُكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the kāf its object and the agent latent; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فِي بُطُونِ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿أُمَّهاتِكُمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿خَلْقاً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿خَلْقٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فِي ظُلُماتٍ﴾ the two are attached to خلق. ﴿ثَلاثٍ﴾ an adjective of ظلمات. ﴿ذلِكُمُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, first khabar (predicate). ﴿رَبُّكُمْ﴾ second khabar. ﴿لَهُ﴾ the two are attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿الْمُلْكُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is a third khabar. ﴿لا﴾ the lā of generic negation. ﴿إِلهَ﴾ its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿هُوَ﴾ badal (substitute) of the pronoun latent in the omitted khabar; the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَأَنَّى﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿تُصْرَفُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:7-7.t: ﴿إِنْ﴾ a jussive conditional particle. ﴿تَكْفُرُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is initial, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ﴾ the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), inna, the Name of Majesty its noun and غني its khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿عَنْكُمْ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to غني. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is negative. ﴿يَرْضى﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its agent latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿لِعِبادِهِ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿الْكُفْرَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ a jussive conditional particle. ﴿تَشْكُرُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its agent. ﴿يَرْضَهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive by the dropping of the weak letter; the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi and the agent is latent; the clause is the apodosis, with no grammatical position. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to يرضه. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle and lā is negative. ﴿تَزِرُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative. ﴿وازِرَةٌ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿وِزْرَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أُخْرى﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the verbal clause is resumptive. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿إِلى رَبِّكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿مَرْجِعُكُمْ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَيُنَبِّئُكُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, nominative, and its object, the agent latent. ﴿بِما﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ kāna and its noun. ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its agent; the clause is the khabar of كنتم, and the clause كنتم is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿عَلِيمٌ﴾ its khabar. ﴿بِذاتِ﴾ the two are attached to عليم. ﴿الصُّدُورِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause gives the reason (taʿlīliyya).

daas-irab:8-8.t: ﴿وَإِذا﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and إذا is an adverbial, non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿مَسَّ الْإِنْسانَ ضُرٌّ﴾ a past verb, its object and a postponed fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿دَعا﴾ a past verb, its agent latent (mustatir). ﴿رَبَّهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مُنِيباً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to the ḥāl. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿إِذا﴾ adverbial, conditional, non-jussive. ﴿خَوَّلَهُ﴾ a past verb and its first object, the agent latent. ﴿نِعْمَةً﴾ its second object; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿نَسِيَ﴾ a past verb, its agent latent. ﴿ما﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿كانَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿يَدْعُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its agent latent. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ the two are attached to يدعو; the clause يدعو is the khabar (predicate) of kāna. ﴿وَجَعَلَ﴾ a past verb, its agent latent. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, genitive by the lām, in the position of the second object. ﴿أَنْداداً﴾ its first object. ﴿لِيُضِلَّ﴾ the lām is for causation (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), the agent latent. ﴿عَنْ سَبِيلِهِ﴾ the two are attached to يضل; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from the implied an and the verb is in the position of genitive by the lām, and the two are attached to the verb يجعل «[Translator's note: so in the source; the verb in the ayah is جعل.]». ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, its agent latent. ﴿تَمَتَّعْ﴾ an imperative verb, its agent latent; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the verb of saying), and the clause قل is resumptive. ﴿بِكُفْرِكَ﴾ the two are attached to تمتع. ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾ a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar. ﴿إِنَّكَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿مِنْ أَصْحابِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, khabar. ﴿النَّارِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause gives the reason, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:9-9.t: ﴿أَمَّنْ﴾ أم in the sense of بل, a particle of digression (iḍrāb), and مَن is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), its khabar (predicate) omitted. ﴿هُوَ قانِتٌ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and its khabar; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿آناءَ﴾ an adverb of time, accusative (manṣūb). ﴿اللَّيْلِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ساجِداً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَقائِماً﴾ conjoined to ساجدا. ﴿يَحْذَرُ الْآخِرَةَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, the fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿وَيَرْجُوا رَحْمَةَ﴾ a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its agent latent, and رحمة is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿رَبِّهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, its agent latent. ﴿هَلْ﴾ an interrogative particle. ﴿يَسْتَوِي الَّذِينَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and its agent; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the verb of saying). ﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its agent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ conjoined. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its agent. ﴿إِنَّما﴾ the restraining mā and the restrained particle (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿يَتَذَكَّرُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative. ﴿أُولُوا﴾ fāʿil, nominative by the wāw. ﴿الْأَلْبابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:10-12.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir). ﴿يا عِبادِ﴾ يا is the vocative particle, and a munādā (the one addressed) that is muḍāf. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a naʿt (adjective) of عبادي. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its agent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿اتَّقُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its agent. ﴿رَبَّكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar (predicate); the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the verb of saying). ﴿أَحْسَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its agent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿فِي هذِهِ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to أحسنوا. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ badal (substitute) of the demonstrative. ﴿حَسَنَةٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿وَأَرْضُ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and a mubtadaʾ. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿واسِعَةٌ﴾ khabar; the nominal clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿إِنَّما﴾ the restraining mā and the restrained particle (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿يُوَفَّى﴾ a passive imperfect verb. ﴿الصَّابِرُونَ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative (marfūʿ) by the wāw; the clause gives the reason for what precedes. ﴿أَجْرَهُمْ﴾ second object. ﴿بِغَيْرِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿حِسابٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, its agent latent. ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿أُمِرْتُ﴾ a passive past verb, and the tāʾ is nāʾib fāʿil. ﴿أَنْ أَعْبُدَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an, the agent latent. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مُخْلِصاً﴾ ḥāl; an and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), accusative by removal of the preposition, and the clause أمرت is the khabar of إني. ﴿لَهُ﴾ the two are attached to the ḥāl مخلصا. ﴿الدِّينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi of the active participle. ﴿وَأُمِرْتُ﴾ a conjunction, and a passive past verb and nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿لِأَنْ﴾ the lām is for causation (taʿlīl), and a particle that makes the verb accusative. ﴿أَكُونَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, accusative, its noun latent. ﴿أَوَّلَ﴾ its khabar. ﴿الْمُسْلِمِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi.

daas-irab:13-16.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir). ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the verb of saying). ﴿أَخافُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its agent latent; the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional. ﴿عَصَيْتُ﴾ a past verb and its agent. ﴿رَبِّي﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿عَذابَ﴾ the object of أخاف. ﴿يَوْمٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عَظِيمٍ﴾ a naʿt (adjective). ﴿قُلِ﴾ an imperative verb, its agent latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, a fronted mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَعْبُدُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its agent latent; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿مُخْلِصاً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿لَهُ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to مخلصا. ﴿دِينِي﴾ mafʿūl bihi of the active participle. ﴿فَاعْبُدُوا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and an imperative verb and its agent. ﴿ما﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿شِئْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its agent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), and the clause اعبدوا is resumptive. ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾ the two are attached to what precedes them. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, its agent latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّ الْخاسِرِينَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, its khabar. ﴿خَسِرُوا﴾ a past verb and its agent. ﴿أَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَأَهْلِيهِمْ﴾ conjoined to أنفسهم. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَلا﴾ a particle of alerting (tanbīh). ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿هُوَ﴾ a second mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْخُسْرانُ﴾ khabar; the clause is resumptive, and the clause هو الخسران is the khabar of ذلك. ﴿الْمُبِينُ﴾ an adjective of خسران. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar. ﴿مِنْ فَوْقِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted second khabar. ﴿ظُلَلٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنَ النَّارِ﴾ an adjective of ظلل. ﴿وَمِنْ تَحْتِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿يُخَوِّفُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of ذلك. ﴿بِهِ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿عِبادَهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يا عِبادِ﴾ يا is the vocative particle, and a munādā (the one addressed) annexed to the yāʾ of the first person, omitted for lightness. ﴿فَاتَّقُونِ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ of the implied condition), and an imperative verb and its agent; the nūn is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya) and the omitted yāʾ of the first person is its object; the verbal clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:17-19.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿اجْتَنَبُوا﴾ a past verb and fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿الطَّاغُوتَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَنْ يَعْبُدُوها﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an, its agent and its object; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from an and what follows it is in the position of accusative as a badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion) of الطاغوت. ﴿وَأَنابُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿لَهُمُ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿الْبُشْرى﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is the khabar of الذين. ﴿فَبَشِّرْ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ of the implied condition), and an imperative verb, its agent latent (mustatir). ﴿عِبادِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative by an implied fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, which is omitted for the sake of the verse-ending (fāṣila). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a naʿt (adjective) of عباد. ﴿يَسْتَمِعُونَ الْقَوْلَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its agent and القول its object; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿فَيَتَّبِعُونَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, nominative, and its agent; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَحْسَنَهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أُولئِكَ الَّذِينَ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and its khabar. ﴿هَداهُمُ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb and its object, and the Name of Majesty is its agent; the clause is the ṣila of الذين. ﴿وَأُولئِكَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a mubtadaʾ. ﴿هُمْ﴾ a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿أُولُوا﴾ the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, nominative by the wāw. ﴿الْأَلْبابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَفَمَنْ﴾ the hamza is a particle of disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī), the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and مَن is the relative noun, a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted. ﴿حَقَّ﴾ a past verb. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿كَلِمَةُ﴾ a postponed agent. ﴿الْعَذابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿أَفَأَنْتَ﴾ the hamza is an interrogative particle, an emphasis of the first, the fāʾ is resumptive, and أنت is a mubtadaʾ. ﴿تُنْقِذُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, its agent latent. ﴿مَنْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the verbal clause is the khabar of أنت, and the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿فِي النَّارِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ṣila.

daas-irab:20-22.t: ﴿لكِنِ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿اتَّقَوْا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿رَبَّهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿غُرَفٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is the khabar of الذين. ﴿مِنْ فَوْقِها﴾ the two are attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿غُرَفٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is a naʿt (adjective) of the first غرف. ﴿مَبْنِيَّةٌ﴾ an adjective of غرف. ﴿تَجْرِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿مِنْ تَحْتِهَا﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿الْأَنْهارُ﴾ a postponed agent; the clause تجري is a third adjective of غرف. ﴿وَعْدَ﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يُخْلِفُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, its agent. ﴿الْمِيعادَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is a particle of affirmative interrogation (istifhām taqrīrī) and lam is a jussive particle. ﴿تَرَ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), its agent latent (mustatir). ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ anna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿أَنْزَلَ﴾ a past verb, its agent latent; the clause أنزل is the khabar of anna, and anna with what follows it stands in place of the two objects of تر. ﴿مِنَ السَّماءِ﴾ the two are attached to أنزل. ﴿ماءً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَسَلَكَهُ﴾ a conjunction, and a past verb and its object, the agent latent. ﴿يَنابِيعَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted adjective of ينابيع. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿يُخْرِجُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its agent latent. ﴿بِهِ﴾ the two are attached to يخرج. ﴿زَرْعاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مُخْتَلِفاً﴾ an adjective of زرعا. ﴿أَلْوانُهُ﴾ the agent of the active participle مختلفا; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, so it is in the position of nominative. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿يَهِيجُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its agent latent. ﴿فَتَراهُ﴾ a conjunction, and an imperfect verb and its object, the agent latent. ﴿مُصْفَرًّا﴾ ḥāl; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿يَجْعَلُهُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its first object, the agent latent. ﴿حُطاماً﴾ its second object. And ﴿أَنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿فِي ذلِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, its fronted khabar. ﴿لَذِكْرى﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and its postponed noun. ﴿لِأُولِي﴾ the two are attached to ذكرى. ﴿الْأَلْبابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَفَمَنْ﴾ an interrogative particle, the fāʾ is resumptive, and the relative noun is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted. ﴿شَرَحَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, agent. ﴿صَدْرَهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لِلْإِسْلامِ﴾ the two are attached to شرح. ﴿فَهُوَ﴾ a conjunction, and a mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَلى نُورٍ﴾ the two are attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّهِ﴾ the two are attached to نور; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, and the clause أفمن شرح is resumptive. ﴿فَوَيْلٌ﴾ a resumptive particle, and a mubtadaʾ. ﴿لِلْقاسِيَةِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿قُلُوبُهُمْ﴾ the agent of قاسية. ﴿مِنْ ذِكْرِ﴾ the two are attached to القاسية. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِي ضَلالٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, khabar. ﴿مُبِينٍ﴾ an adjective of ضلال; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:23-25.t: ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿نَزَّلَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir). ﴿أَحْسَنَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the nominal clause is initial, with no grammatical position. ﴿الْحَدِيثِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿كِتاباً﴾ badal (substitute) of أحسن. ﴿مُتَشابِهاً﴾ first naʿt (adjective). ﴿مَثانِيَ﴾ second adjective. ﴿تَقْشَعِرُّ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿مِنْهُ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿جُلُودُ﴾ a postponed agent. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يَخْشَوْنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and its agent. ﴿رَبَّهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿تَلِينُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative. ﴿جُلُودُهُمْ﴾ agent. ﴿وَقُلُوبُهُمْ﴾ conjoined to جلودهم. ﴿إِلى ذِكْرِ﴾ the two are attached to تلين. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿هُدَى﴾ its khabar (predicate). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يَهْدِي﴾ an imperfect verb, its agent latent; the clause is the ṣila «[Translator's note: so in the source.]», and the clause تقشعر is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿بِهِ﴾ the two are attached to يهدي. ﴿مَنْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and مَن is a jussive conditional noun, a fronted object. ﴿يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the Name of Majesty is the agent. ﴿فَما﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) and mā is negative. ﴿لَهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition «[Translator's note: the word is مِنْ in the ayah.]». ﴿هادٍ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, and the conditional sentence is resumptive. ﴿أَفَمَنْ﴾ the hamza is a particle of disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī), the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and a relative noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَتَّقِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, its agent latent. ﴿بِوَجْهِهِ﴾ the two are attached to يتقي. ﴿سُوءَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْعَذابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَقِيلَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a passive past verb; the clause is conjoined to يتقي. ﴿لِلظَّالِمِينَ﴾ the two are attached to قيل. ﴿ذُوقُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its agent; the clause is in the position of nominative as the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of قيل. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ kāna and its noun. ﴿تَكْسِبُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the agent is the wāw of the plural; the clause is the khabar of كنتم, and the clause كنتم is the ṣila. ﴿كَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ﴾ a past verb and its agent. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to the omitted ṣila of the relative noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَأَتاهُمُ﴾ a conjunction, and a past verb and its object. ﴿الْعَذابُ﴾ a postponed agent. ﴿مِنْ حَيْثُ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يَشْعُرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is its agent; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).

daas-irab:26-31.t: ﴿فَأَذاقَهُمُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its object. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, a postponed fāʿil (agent). ﴿الْخِزْيَ﴾ second object. ﴿فِي الْحَياةِ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ a naʿt (adjective). ﴿وَلَعَذابُ﴾ a resumptive particle; the lām is the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ) and عذاب is a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الْآخِرَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَكْبَرُ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿لَوْ﴾ conditional, non-jussive. ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its noun; the clause كانوا is initial. ﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its agent; the clause is the khabar of كانوا, and the clause عذاب الآخرة is resumptive. ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, the lām occurs in the response to the omitted oath, and qad is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿ضَرَبْنا﴾ a past verb and its agent; the clause is the response to the oath, with no grammatical position. ﴿لِلنَّاسِ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿فِي هذَا﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿الْقُرْآنِ﴾ badal (substitute) of the demonstrative. ﴿مِنْ كُلِّ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿مَثَلٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ﴾ laʿalla and its noun. ﴿يَتَذَكَّرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its agent; the verbal clause is the khabar of laʿalla. ﴿قُرْآناً﴾ ḥāl, accusative (manṣūb). ﴿عَرَبِيًّا﴾ an adjective. ﴿غَيْرَ﴾ a second adjective. ﴿ذِي﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عِوَجٍ﴾ a second muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ﴾ laʿalla and its noun. ﴿يَتَّقُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is its agent; the verbal clause is the khabar of laʿalla. ﴿ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is its agent. ﴿مَثَلًا﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿رَجُلًا﴾ badal of مثلا; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ the two are attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿شُرَكاءُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is an adjective of رجلا. ﴿مُتَشاكِسُونَ﴾ an adjective of شركاء, nominative by the wāw. ﴿وَرَجُلًا﴾ conjoined to the first رجلا. ﴿سَلَماً﴾ its adjective. ﴿لِرَجُلٍ﴾ the two are attached to سلما. ﴿هَلْ﴾ an interrogative particle. ﴿يَسْتَوِيانِ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and the agent is the alif of the dual. ﴿مَثَلًا﴾ tamyīz (specification); the clause is resumptive. ﴿الْحَمْدُ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿أَكْثَرُهُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw of the plural is its agent; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّكَ مَيِّتٌ﴾ inna, its noun and its khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَإِنَّهُمْ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿مَيِّتُونَ﴾ the khabar of inna; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿إِنَّكُمْ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ an adverb of place. ﴿رَبِّكُمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿تَخْتَصِمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw of the plural is its agent; the clause is the khabar of inna, and the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:32-36.t: ﴿فَمَنْ﴾ a resumptive particle, and an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَظْلَمُ﴾ khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِمَّنْ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb «[Translator's note: so in the source; the governing word here is the elative أظلم.]». ﴿كَذَبَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir). ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿وَكَذَّبَ بِالصِّدْقِ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative. ﴿جاءَهُ﴾ a past verb and its object, the agent latent; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿أَلَيْسَ﴾ a particle of affirmative interrogation (istifhām taqrīrī), and an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿فِي جَهَنَّمَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, its fronted khabar. ﴿مَثْوىً﴾ its postponed noun; the clause كذب is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿لِلْكافِرِينَ﴾ the two are attached to مثوى; the clause أليس is resumptive. ﴿وَالَّذِي﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and a relative noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿جاءَ﴾ a past verb, its agent latent. ﴿بِالصِّدْقِ﴾ the two are attached to the verb; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَصَدَّقَ﴾ a past verb, its agent latent; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿بِهِ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿هُمُ﴾ a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿الْمُتَّقُونَ﴾ the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ) by the wāw; the nominal clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ الذي, and the clause الذي is resumptive. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَشاؤُنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its agent. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ an adverb of place. ﴿رَبِّهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the ṣila. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿جَزاءُ﴾ its khabar. ﴿الْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ; the clause is resumptive, and the clause لهم is resumptive. ﴿لِيُكَفِّرَ اللَّهُ﴾ the lām is for causation (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied after the lām, and the Name of Majesty is its agent; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of genitive by the lām, and the preposition with its genitive noun are attached to المحسنين. ﴿عَنْهُمْ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿أَسْوَأَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الَّذِي﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَمِلُوا﴾ a past verb and its agent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَيَجْزِيَهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, the agent latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَجْرَهُمْ﴾ second object. ﴿بِأَحْسَنِ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its noun. ﴿يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its agent; the clause is the khabar of كانوا, and the clause كانوا is the ṣila. ﴿أَلَيْسَ﴾ the hamza is a particle of affirmative interrogation, and an incomplete past verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, the noun of laysa. ﴿بِكافٍ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and a noun genitive in form, accusative in position, the khabar of laysa. ﴿عَبْدَهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi of the active participle كاف; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَيُخَوِّفُونَكَ﴾ the wāw is of the ḥāl (circumstantial), and an imperfect verb, nominative; the wāw is its agent and the kāf its object. ﴿بِالَّذِينَ﴾ the two are attached to the verb; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ṣila. ﴿وَمَنْ يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَما لَهُ مِنْ هادٍ﴾: its i'rab is in ayah 23.

daas-irab:37-38.t: ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and مَن is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَهْدِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter; it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, its fāʿil (agent). ﴿فَما﴾ the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa) and mā is negative. ﴿لَهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿مَنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition «[Translator's note: the word is مِنْ in the ayah.]». ﴿مُضِلٍّ﴾ a noun genitive in form, nominative in position, a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause فماله.. is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis are the khabar of مَن. ﴿أَلَيْسَ﴾ the hamza is a particle of interrogation and affirmation (taqrīr), and an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, its noun. ﴿بِعَزِيزٍ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant preposition, and عزيز is genitive in form, accusative in position, the khabar of laysa. ﴿ذِي﴾ a naʿt (adjective) of عزيز. ﴿انْتِقامٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the verbal clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلَئِنْ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, the lām prepares for the oath (al-lām al-muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam), and in is conditional. ﴿سَأَلْتَهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its agent and its object. ﴿مَنْ﴾ an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿خَلَقَ السَّماواتِ﴾ a past verb and its object, the agent latent (mustatir); the clause is the khabar of مَن. ﴿وَالْأَرْضَ﴾ conjoined to السموات; the nominal clause is in the position of accusative as the second object of سألتهم. ﴿لَيَقُولُنَّ﴾ the lām occurs in the response to the oath, and the apodosis is omitted; an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, which is omitted because of the succession of like letters, and the omitted wāw is its agent. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted; the clause is the response to the oath, with no grammatical position, and the nominal clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the verb of saying). ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, its agent latent. ﴿أَفَرَأَيْتُمْ﴾ the hamza is an interrogative particle, the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ of the implied condition), and a past verb and its agent. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿تَدْعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its agent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional, jussive. ﴿أَرادَنِيَ﴾ a past verb and its object. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, a postponed agent. ﴿بِضُرٍّ﴾ the two are attached to the verb; the clause is initial, with no grammatical position. ﴿هَلْ﴾ an interrogative particle. ﴿هُنَّ كاشِفاتُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and its khabar. ﴿ضُرِّهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the nominal clause is the second object of رأيتم. ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿أَرادَنِيَ﴾ a past verb and its object; the clause is conjoined to what precedes. ﴿بِرَحْمَةٍ هَلْ هُنَّ مُمْسِكاتُ رَحْمَتِهِ﴾ the i'rab is clear, and the statement is conjoined to what precedes. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, its agent latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿حَسْبِيَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, khabar; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ the two are attached to يتوكل. ﴿يَتَوَكَّلُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative. ﴿الْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ﴾ agent, nominative by the wāw; the clause is also the maqūl al-qawl.

daas-irab:39-41.t:
﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir). ﴿يا قَوْمِ﴾ يا is the vocative particle, and قوم is a munādā (the one addressed) annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the verb of saying), and the clause قل is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿اعْمَلُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its agent. ﴿عَلى مَكانَتِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿عامِلٌ﴾ its khabar (predicate); the clause اعملوا is the maqūl al-qawl, and the nominal clause gives the reason (taʿlīl). ﴿فَسَوْفَ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle and sawfa is a particle of the future. ﴿تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its agent; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of تعلمون. ﴿يَأْتِيهِ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object. ﴿عَذابٌ﴾ a postponed agent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿يُخْزِيهِ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, with a latent agent; the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of عذاب. ﴿وَيَحِلُّ﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿عَذابٌ﴾ a postponed agent; the clause is conjoined to يخزيه. ﴿مُقِيمٌ﴾ an adjective, nominative. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿أَنْزَلْنا﴾ a past verb and its agent; the clause is the khabar of inna, and the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لِلنَّاسِ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿فَمَنِ﴾ a conjunction, and مَن is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿اهْتَدى﴾ a past verb, its agent latent. ﴿فَلِنَفْسِهِ﴾ the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), and a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "فهدايته لنفسه" (then his guidance is for himself); the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis are the khabar of مَن. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and مَن is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿ضَلَّ﴾ a past verb, its agent latent. ﴿فَإِنَّما﴾ the fāʾ is connective, and إنما is the restraining mā and the restrained particle (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿يَضِلُّ﴾ an imperfect verb, its agent latent. ﴿عَلَيْها﴾ the two are attached to the verb; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle and mā is negative. ﴿أَنْتَ﴾ its noun. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to وكيل. ﴿بِوَكِيلٍ﴾ genitive in form by the redundant (zāʾida) bāʾ, accusative in position, the khabar of mā; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:42-44.t: ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَتَوَفَّى الْأَنْفُسَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), and الأنفس is its object; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿حِينَ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿مَوْتِها﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَالَّتِي﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and التي is conjoined to الأنفس. ﴿لَمْ تَمُتْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lam, its agent latent. ﴿فِي مَنامِها﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to تمت; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فَيُمْسِكُ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and an imperfect verb, its agent latent. ﴿الَّتِي﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿قَضى﴾ a past verb. ﴿عَلَيْهَا﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿الْمَوْتَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause يمسك is resumptive. ﴿وَيُرْسِلُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, nominative, its agent latent; the clause is conjoined to يمسك. ﴿الْأُخْرى﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِلى أَجَلٍ﴾ the two are attached to يرسل. ﴿مُسَمًّى﴾ a naʿt (adjective) of أجل. ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿فِي ذلِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar. ﴿لَآياتٍ﴾ the lām is the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ), and آيات is the postponed noun of inna. ﴿لِقَوْمٍ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted adjective of آيات. ﴿يَتَفَكَّرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its agent; the clause is an adjective of قوم, and the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿أَمِ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿اتَّخَذُوا﴾ a past verb and its agent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾ the two are attached to اتخذوا. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿شُفَعاءَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, its agent latent. ﴿أَوَلَوْ﴾ the hamza is a particle of disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī), the wāw is of the ḥāl (circumstantial), and law is conditional. ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its noun. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يَمْلِكُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its agent; the clause is the khabar of kāna, and the clause كانوا is a ḥāl. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَلا يَعْقِلُونَ﴾ conjoined. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, its agent latent. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ the two are attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿الشَّفاعَةُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿جَمِيعاً﴾ ḥāl; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the verb of saying). ﴿لَهُ﴾ the two are attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿مُلْكُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ the two are attached to the verb after them. ﴿تُرْجَعُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:45-47.t: ﴿وَإِذا﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and إذا is an adverbial, non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿ذُكِرَ﴾ a passive past verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿وَحْدَهُ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿اشْمَأَزَّتْ﴾ a past verb. ﴿قُلُوبُ﴾ fāʿil (agent). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position. ﴿لا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ lā is negative, and يؤمنون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its agent. ﴿بِالْآخِرَةِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَإِذا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and إذا is conditional, non-jussive. ﴿ذُكِرَ﴾ a passive past verb; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾ the two are attached to the omitted ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿إِذا﴾ of surprise (fujāʾiyya). ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its agent; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is the apodosis, with no grammatical position. ﴿قُلِ﴾ an imperative verb, its agent latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿اللَّهُمَّ﴾ munādā (the one addressed), and the doubled mīm is a substitute for the vocative particle. ﴿فاطِرَ﴾ badal (substitute) of اللهم. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿عالِمَ﴾ badal. ﴿الْغَيْبِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالشَّهادَةِ﴾ conjoined to الغيب. ﴿أَنْتَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿تَحْكُمُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, its agent latent; the clause is the khabar. ﴿بَيْنَ﴾ an adverb of place. ﴿عِبادِكَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فِي ما﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its noun. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ the two are attached to يختلفون; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿يَخْتَلِفُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its agent; the clause is the khabar. ﴿وَلَوْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive. ﴿لَوْ﴾ conditional, jussive «[Translator's note: so in the source; law is normally described as a non-jussive conditional particle.]». ﴿أَنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾ the two are attached to the khabar. ﴿ظَلَمُوا﴾ the clause is the ṣila. ﴿ما﴾ the postponed noun of anna. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ the ṣila of ما. ﴿جَمِيعاً﴾ ḥāl. ﴿وَمِثْلَهُ﴾ conjoined to ما. ﴿مَعَهُ﴾ an adverb. ﴿لَافْتَدَوْا﴾ the lām occurs in the response to law, and a past verb and its agent. ﴿بِهِ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿مِنْ سُوءِ الْعَذابِ﴾ the two are attached to the verb, and العذاب is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَبَدا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ the two are also attached to the verb. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, the agent of بدا. ﴿لَمْ﴾ jussive. ﴿يَكُونُوا﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, and the wāw is its noun; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿يَحْتَسِبُونَ﴾ the clause is the khabar.

daas-irab:48-50.t: ﴿وَبَدا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to بدا. ﴿سَيِّئاتُ﴾ fāʿil (agent). ﴿ما﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿كَسَبُوا﴾ a past verb and its agent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), and the clause بدا is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَحاقَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿بِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to حاق. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, the agent of حاق. ﴿كانُوا﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb and its noun; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿بِهِ﴾ the two are attached to يستهزئون. ﴿يَسْتَهْزِؤُنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its agent; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of كانوا. ﴿فَإِذا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and إذا is an adverbial, non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿مَسَّ الْإِنْسانَ ضُرٌّ﴾ a past verb, its object and a postponed agent; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿دَعانا﴾ a past verb and its object, with a latent (mustatir) agent; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿إِذا﴾ adverbial, conditional, non-jussive. ﴿خَوَّلْناهُ﴾ a past verb, its agent and its first object. ﴿نِعْمَةً﴾ its second object. ﴿مِنَّا﴾ the two are attached to نعمة. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb, its agent latent; the clause is the apodosis. ﴿إِنَّما﴾ the restraining mā and the restrained particle (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿أُوتِيتُهُ﴾ a passive past verb; the tāʾ is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿عَلى عِلْمٍ﴾ the two are attached to the verb; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the verb of saying). ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of transitional digression (iḍrāb intiqālī). ﴿هِيَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿فِتْنَةٌ﴾ khabar. ﴿وَلكِنَّ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a particle resembling the verb. ﴿أَكْثَرَهُمْ﴾ its noun; the nominal clause is resumptive, and the clause ولكن is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its agent; the clause is the khabar of lākinna. ﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿قالَهَا﴾ a past verb and its object. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ its agent. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ṣila. ﴿فَما﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction and mā is negative. ﴿أَغْنى﴾ a past verb. ﴿عَنْهُمْ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿ما﴾ a postponed agent. ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its noun; the clause is the ṣila of ما. ﴿يَكْسِبُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is its agent; the clause is the khabar of كانوا.

daas-irab:51-52.t: ﴿فَأَصابَهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its object. ﴿سَيِّئاتُ﴾ a postponed fāʿil (agent). ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position. ﴿كَسَبُوا﴾ a past verb and agent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ the relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿ظَلَمُوا﴾ a past verb and its agent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مِنْ هؤُلاءِ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿سَيُصِيبُهُمْ﴾ the sīn is a particle of the future, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and its object. ﴿سَيِّئاتُ﴾ a postponed agent. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كَسَبُوا﴾ a past verb and its agent; the clause is the ṣila, the clause سيصيبهم is the khabar (predicate) of الذين, and the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is of the ḥāl, and mā is negative, operating like laysa. ﴿هُمْ﴾ its noun. ﴿بِمُعْجِزِينَ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; معجزين is genitive in form, accusative in position as the khabar of mā; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿أَوَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is a particle of disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī), the wāw is a resumptive particle, and lam is a jussive particle. ﴿يَعْلَمُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lam, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its agent. ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ anna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿يَبْسُطُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative. ﴿الرِّزْقَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the khabar of anna, anna with what follows it stands in place of the two objects of يعلم, and the clause يعلم is resumptive. ﴿لِمَنْ﴾ the two are attached to يبسط. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, its agent latent (mustatir); the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَيَقْدِرُ﴾ conjoined to يشاء. ﴿أَنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿فِي ذلِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, its fronted khabar. ﴿لَآياتٍ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); آيات is the noun of inna, accusative (manṣūb) by the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿لِقَوْمٍ﴾ the two are attached to the verb after them. ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of قوم.

daas-irab:53-55.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir). ﴿يا عِبادِيَ﴾ يا is the vocative particle, and a munādā (the one addressed) that is muḍāf, and the yāʾ of the first person is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a naʿt (adjective) of عبادي. ﴿أَسْرَفُوا﴾ a past verb and its agent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), the clause قل is resumptive, and the clause يا عبادي is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the verb of saying). ﴿عَلى أَنْفُسِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to أسرفوا. ﴿لا﴾ of prohibition. ﴿تَقْنَطُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the wāw is its agent. ﴿مِنْ رَحْمَةِ﴾ the two are attached to تقنطوا. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿يَغْفِرُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its agent latent; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿الذُّنُوبَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿جَمِيعاً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿هُوَ﴾ a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿الْغَفُورُ﴾ the khabar of inna. ﴿الرَّحِيمُ﴾ a second khabar; the nominal clause gives the reason (taʿlīl). ﴿وَأَنِيبُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb and its agent. ﴿إِلى رَبِّكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, so it is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿وَأَسْلِمُوا﴾ conjoined to أنيبوا. ﴿لَهُ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِ﴾ the two are also attached to the verb. ﴿أَنْ يَأْتِيَكُمُ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an, and its object. ﴿الْعَذابُ﴾ a postponed agent. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿تُنْصَرُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿وَاتَّبِعُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb and its agent. ﴿أَحْسَنَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أُنْزِلَ﴾ a passive past verb with a latent nāʾib fāʿil. ﴿إِلَيْكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to أنزل. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿أَنْ يَأْتِيَكُمُ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an, and the kāf is its object. ﴿الْعَذابُ﴾ a postponed agent. ﴿بَغْتَةً﴾ ḥāl; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from an and what follows it is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).
