muyesser-irab:57-57.t: ﴿أو تقول لو أن الله هداني لكنت من المتقين﴾: أو: a conjunction; تقول: an imperfect verb, conjoined to the earlier ﴿تقول﴾, accusative (manṣūb) with fatḥa, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هي", referring back to نفس; لو: conditional; أن: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); الله: the Divine Name, the ism (noun) of إن, accusative [Translator's note: the source writes «اسم إن» here although the particle in the verse is أنّ]; هداني: a past verb, mabnī (indeclinable) on an implied fatḥa on the alif, the fāʿil is "هو", the nūn is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the lām falls in the answer of لو; كنت: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the tāʾ is its ism, in the position of nominative; من المتقين: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of كنت; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن الله هداني﴾ is the fāʿil of an omitted verb, i.e. "ثبت" (it were established); the clause ﴿كنت من المتقين﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; and the clause of saying has no grammatical position, being conjoined to its counterpart.

muyesser-irab:58-58.t: ﴿أو تقول حين ترى العذاب لو أن لي كرة فأكون من المحسنين﴾: أو: a conjunction; تقول: an imperfect verb, conjoined to the earlier ﴿تقول﴾, accusative (manṣūb) with fatḥa, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هي", referring back to نفس; حين: accusative as an adverb of time (ẓarf); ترى: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma, and the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "هي"; العذاب: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with fatḥa; لو: conditional; أن: an abrogating particle; لي: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate) of أن; كرة: the postponed ism (noun) of أن; فأكون: the fāʾ: conjunctive, and أكون is conjoined to كرة; or the fāʾ is causative (sababiyya), and أكون is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the causative fāʾ, and the interpreted maṣdar from أن and the verb is conjoined to a maṣdar understood from the preceding speech, the implied sense being: "would that there were a return for me, and so my being among the good-doers"; ﴿من المحسنين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أكون﴾; the clause ﴿تقول﴾ has no grammatical position, being maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the earlier ﴿تقول نفس﴾; and the clause ﴿ترى...﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:59-59.t:
﴿بلى﴾: a particle of reply, for cancelling the negation contained in the speaker's words ﴿لو أن الله هداني﴾.
﴿قد﴾: a particle of verification (taḥqīq).
﴿جاءتك﴾: جاء: a past verb, mabnī (indeclinable) on fatḥa; the tāʾ: for the feminine; and the kāf: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿آياتي﴾: fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person; and the yāʾ: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿فكذبت﴾: the fāʾ: conjunctive; كذب: a past verb, mabnī on sukūn; and the tāʾ: in the position of nominative as fāʿil.
﴿بها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿كذبت﴾.
﴿واستكبرت﴾: the wāw: conjunctive; استكبرت: a past verb, mabnī on sukūn; and the tāʾ: in the position of nominative as fāʿil.
﴿وكنت﴾: the wāw: conjunctive; كان: an abrogating (nāsikh) past verb; and the tāʾ: in the position of nominative as its ism (noun).
﴿من الكافرين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun (genitive with the yāʾ), attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of كنت; the clause ﴿قد جاءتك آياتي﴾ is in the position of accusative as the object of an implied saying, i.e. "Allah said"; and the clauses ﴿كذبت﴾, ﴿استكبرت﴾, ﴿كنت﴾ are in the position of accusative, conjoined (maʿṭūfāt) to ﴿جاءتك آياتي﴾.

muyesser-irab:60-60.t:
﴿ويوم القيامة ترى الذين كذبوا على الله وجوههم مسودة﴾: the wāw: resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; يوم: an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān), accusative (manṣūb), attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ترى﴾; القيامة: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); ترى: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "أنت"; الذين: a relative noun, mabnī (indeclinable) on fatḥa, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); كذبوا: a past verb, mabnī on ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil; على الله: على: a preposition, and the Divine Name is a genitive noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿كذبوا﴾; the clause ﴿كذبوا على الله﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; وجوههم: mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative, and هم: in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; مسودة: khabar (predicate), nominative with ḍamma; and the clause ﴿وجوههم مسودة﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the relative noun.
﴿أليس في جهنم مثوى للمتكبرين﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of affirmation (istifhām taqrīrī); ليس: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, mabnī on fatḥa; في جهنم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar of ليس; مثوى: the postponed ism (noun) of ليس, nominative with an implied ḍamma; للمتكبرين: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of مثوى; and the clause ﴿أليس في جهنم مثوى..﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is causal (taʿlīliyya).

muyesser-irab:61-61.t:
﴿وينجي الله الذين اتقوا بمفازتهم﴾: the wāw: conjunctive; ينجي: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ; الله: the Divine Name, fāʿil (agent); الذين: a relative noun, mabnī (indeclinable) on fatḥa, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); اتقوا: a past verb, mabnī on an implied ḍamma on the alif, and the wāw is the fāʿil; بمفازتهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ينجي﴾, and the pronoun is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿ينجي..﴾ has no grammatical position, being maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause ﴿ترى..﴾; and the clause ﴿اتقوا..﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿لا يمسهم السوء ولا هم يحزنون﴾: لا: negating; يمسهم: an imperfect verb, nominative with ḍamma, and the hāʾ is a pronoun, mabnī, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, and the mīm is the sign of the plural; السوء: fāʿil, nominative with ḍamma; the wāw: conjunctive; لا: negating; هم: mubtadaʾ (subject); يحزنون: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿يحزنون﴾ is in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿لا يمسهم السوء﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from الذين, or it is an explanatory resumptive clause (mustaʾnafa bayāniyyan) with no grammatical position; and the clause ﴿لا هم يحزنون﴾ is conjoined to ﴿لا يمسهم السوء﴾.

muyesser-irab:62-62.t:
﴿الله﴾: the Divine Name, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ) with ḍamma.
﴿خالق﴾: khabar (predicate), nominative with ḍamma.
﴿كل﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) with kasra.
﴿شيء﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with kasra.
﴿وهو﴾: the wāw: conjunctive; هو: a pronoun, mabnī (indeclinable) on fatḥa, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ.
﴿على كل﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿وكيل﴾.
﴿شيء﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with kasra.
﴿وكيل﴾: khabar, nominative with ḍamma; the clause ﴿الله خالق..﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is resumptive; and the clause ﴿هو على كل شيء وكيل﴾ has no grammatical position, being maʿṭūf (conjoined) to ﴿الله خالق..﴾.

muyesser-irab:63-63.t:
﴿له مقاليد السماوات والأرض﴾: له: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); مقاليد: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ) with ḍamma; السماوات: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) with kasra; الأرض: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to السماوات, genitive; and the clause ﴿له مقاليد﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is resumptive (mustaʾnafa).
﴿والذين كفروا بآيات الله أولئك هم الخاسرون﴾: the wāw: resumptive; الذين: a relative noun, mabnī (indeclinable) on fatḥa, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; كفروا: a past verb, mabnī on ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); بآيات: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿كفروا﴾; الله: the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ﴿كفروا بآيات الله﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; أولئك: a demonstrative, mabnī, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; هم: a pronoun, mabnī, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; الخاسرون: the khabar of ﴿أولئك﴾ or of ﴿هم﴾, nominative with the wāw; the clause ﴿أولئك هم الخاسرون﴾ is in the position of nominative as the khabar of الذين; and the clause ﴿والذين كفروا بآيات الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:1-1.t: ﴿تنزيل الكتاب من الله العزيز الحكيم﴾: (تنزيل): mubtadaʾ (subject); (الكتاب): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (من الله): (من) is a preposition and the Name of Majesty is a genitive noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); (العزيز الحكيم): two naʿts (adjectives). Or (تنزيل) is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "this is a sending down", and (من الله) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the maṣdar (verbal noun).

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿إنا أنزلنا إليك الكتاب بالحق﴾: (إنا): (إن) is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and (نا), whose nūn has been dropped for lightness, is its noun; (أنزلنا): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and (نا) is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿أنزلنا﴾ is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿إنا أنزلنا..﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; (إليك): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أنزلنا﴾; (الكتاب): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and (بالحق): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the sending down, i.e. "because of the truth", or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil or from the object, i.e. "bearing the truth" (plural) or "bearing the truth" (singular).
﴿فاعبد الله مخلصا له الدين﴾: the fāʾ: connective (rābiṭa); (اعبد): imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the Name of Majesty ﴿الله﴾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (مخلصًا): ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb); (له): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مخلصًا﴾; and (الدين): mafʿūl bihi of the active participle ﴿مخلصا﴾.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿ألا لله الدين الخالص﴾: (ألا): a particle of drawing attention and opening; (لله): the lām is a preposition and the Name of Majesty is a genitive noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); (الدين): postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); and (الخالص): a naʿt (adjective).
﴿والذين اتخذوا من دونه أولياء ما نعبدهم إلا ليقربونا إلى الله زلفى﴾: the wāw: resumptive; (الذين): an indeclinable (mabnī) relative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (اتخذوا): past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the clause ﴿اتخذوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. (من دونه): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), or a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (أولياء): first mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿ما نعبدهم﴾ is the object of an omitted verb of saying which is the khabar (predicate) of (الذين), i.e. "they say"; (ما): negating; (نعبدهم): imperfect verb, latent (mustatir) fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; (إلا): a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (ليقربونا): the lām is for purpose (taʿlīl), and (يقربونا) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) «أن» after the lām of purpose, the wāw is the fāʿil and (نا) is the mafʿūl bihi; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from «أن» and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿نعبدهم﴾; (إلى الله): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يقربونا﴾; (زلفى): standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) according to the meaning, because it is a maṣdar of the meaning of the governing word, i.e. "that they bring us near a nearness"; and the clause ﴿والذين اتخذوا...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿إن الله يحكم بينهم في ما هم فيه يختلفون﴾: (إن): an abrogating particle, the Name of Majesty is its noun, and the clause ﴿يحكم﴾ is its khabar (predicate); some allowed His words ﴿إن الله يحكم بينهم﴾ to be the khabar of (الذين), in which case the position of the implied saying is the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "saying that"; (بينهم): an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يحكم﴾; (فيما): a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to ﴿يحكم﴾; (هم): mubtadaʾ (subject); (فيه): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يختلفون﴾; the clause ﴿يختلفون﴾ is the khabar of ﴿هم﴾; and the clause ﴿هم فيه يختلفون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿إن الله لا يهدي من هو كاذب كفار﴾: (إن): an abrogating particle, and the Name of Majesty ﴿الله﴾ is its noun; (لا): negating; (يهدي): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the clause ﴿لا يهدي﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of (إن); the fāʿil (agent) of ﴿يهدي﴾ is latent (mustatir), referring to the Name of Majesty; (من): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (هو): mubtadaʾ (subject); (كاذب) and (كفار): two khabars of it; and the clause ﴿هو كاذب كفار﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿لو أراد الله أن يتخذ ولدا لاصطفى مما يخلق ما يشاء﴾: (لو): a non-jussive conditional particle; (أراد): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أن يتخذ﴾ is the object of ﴿أراد﴾, accusative (manṣūb); the lām: in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (اصطفى): past verb, indeclinable on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif, and its fāʿil is "He", i.e. Allah the Exalted, and the clause has no grammatical position; (مما): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اصطفى﴾; the clause ﴿يخلق﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. (ما): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause ﴿يشاء﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. The referent pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, i.e. "He wills it".
﴿سبحانه هو الله الواحد القهار﴾: (سبحانه): standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative (manṣūb) by an omitted verb, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (هو): mubtadaʾ (subject); the Name of Majesty ﴿الله﴾ is its khabar (predicate); and (الواحد القهار): two nominative (marfūʿ) naʿts (adjectives) of ﴿الله﴾.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿خلق السماوات والأرض بالحق﴾: (خلق): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), referring to Allah the Exalted; (السماوات): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) by the kasra; (الأرض): conjoined to (السماوات), accusative by the fatḥa; and (بالحق): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خلق﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from its fāʿil or from its object.
﴿يكور الليل على النهار ويكور النهار على الليل﴾: (يكور): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil (agent) is "He"; (الليل): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (على النهار): attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يكور﴾; the clause ﴿يكور الليل على النهار﴾ is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), or resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; and the clause ﴿يكور النهار على الليل﴾ is conjoined to its counterpart.
﴿وسخر الشمس والقمر﴾: the wāw: a conjunction; (سخر): indeclinable (mabnī) past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "He"; (الشمس): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (القمر): conjoined to (الشمس), accusative; and the clause ﴿وسخر الشمس والقمر﴾ is conjoined to ﴿خلق السماوات والأرض﴾.
﴿كل يجري لأجل مسمى ألا هو العزيز الغفار﴾: (كل): mubtadaʾ (subject); (يجري): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ, and the fāʿil (agent) is "it"; the clause ﴿يجري﴾ is the khabar (predicate); (لأجل): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يجري﴾; (مسمى): a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أجل﴾; (ألا): a particle of drawing attention; (هو): mubtadaʾ; and (العزيز الغفار): two khabars of ﴿هو﴾.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿خلقكم من نفس واحدة ثم جعل منها زوجها﴾: (خلق): indeclinable (mabnī) past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "He"; the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the mīm is for the plural; (من نفس): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خلقكم﴾; (واحدة): a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿نفس﴾; (ثم): a particle of sequence with delay; (جعل): past verb, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), referring to Allah the Exalted; (منها): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿جعل﴾, or to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi; (زوجها): mafʿūl bihi, and (ها) is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وأنزل لكم من الأنعام ثمانية أزواج﴾: the wāw: a conjunction; (أنزل): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and the clause ﴿أنزل﴾ is conjoined to ﴿خلقكم﴾; (لكم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); (من الأنعام): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أنزل﴾; (ثمانية): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and (أزواج): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) by the kasra.
﴿يخلقكم في بطون أمهاتكم خلقا من بعد خلق في ظلمات ثلاث﴾: (يخلقكم): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the fāʿil (agent) is "He", the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the mīm is for the plural; (في بطون أمهاتكم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يخلقكم﴾; (خلقا): mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); (من بعد): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of ﴿خلقا﴾; (خلق): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (في ظلمات): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the genitive ﴿خلق﴾ before it; and the clause ﴿يخلقكم في بطون...﴾ is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), or resumptive, with no grammatical position. [Translator's note: the source does not parse (ثلاث).]
﴿ذلكم الله ربكم له الملك﴾: (ذلكم): mubtadaʾ (subject); the Name of Majesty ﴿الله﴾ is its first khabar (predicate); (ربكم): its second khabar; (له): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar; (الملك): postponed mubtadaʾ; and the nominal clause ﴿له الملك﴾ is in the position of the nominative as a third khabar.
﴿لا﴾: the lā of generic negation.
﴿إله﴾: its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿هو﴾: a badal (substitute) from the position of (لا) and its noun, because its position is the nominative as the subject of a nominal sentence (al-ibtidāʾ), or a badal from the pronoun concealed in the omitted khabar (predicate). The clause ﴿لا إله إلا هو﴾ is in the position of the nominative as a fourth khabar.
﴿فأنى تصرفون﴾: the fāʾ: resumptive; (أنى): an interrogative noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); (تصرفون): imperfect verb, built for that whose agent is not named [i.e. passive], and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and the clause ﴿فأنى تصرفون﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿إن تكفروا فإن الله غني عنكم ولا يرضى لعباده الكفر وإن تشكروا يرضه لكم﴾: (إن): a jussive conditional particle; (تكفروا): the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw: fāʿil (agent); the fāʾ: in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (إن): an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); the Name of Majesty is the noun of (إن); (غني): the khabar (predicate) of (إن), nominative (marfūʿ); the clause ﴿إن الله غني﴾ is the apodosis; (عنكم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿غني﴾; (لا): negating; (يرضى): imperfect verb, nominative by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif, and the fāʿil is "He"; (لعباده): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يرضى﴾; (الكفر): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (إن): a jussive conditional particle; (تشكروا): the protasis, an imperfect verb, jussive by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw: fāʿil; the clause ﴿إن تشكروا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿إن تكفروا﴾; (يرضه): the apodosis, an imperfect verb, jussive by the dropping of the alif, the fāʿil is "He", and the hāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi; and (لكم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يرضه﴾.
﴿ولا تزر وازرة وزر أخرى ثم إلى ربكم مرجعكم﴾: the wāw: a conjunction; (لا): negating; (تزر): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); (وازرة): fāʿil (agent); (وزر): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (أخرى): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), on the assumption of an omitted qualified noun, i.e. "another soul"; (ثم): a conjunction of delay; (إلى ربكم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); (مرجعكم): postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), and ﴿كم﴾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿فينبئكم بما كنتم تعملون﴾: the fāʾ: a conjunction; (ينبئكم): imperfect verb, the fāʿil (agent) is "He", the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the mīm is for the plural; (بما): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ينبئكم﴾; (كنتم): (كان) is a deficient past verb (one of kāna and its sisters), and ﴿تم﴾ is its noun; the clause ﴿تعملون﴾ is its khabar (predicate); and the clause ﴿كنتم تعملون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿إنه عليم بذات الصدور﴾: (إن): an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and the hāʾ is its noun; (عليم): the khabar (predicate) of (إن), nominative (marfūʿ); (بذات): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿عليم﴾; and (الصدور): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) by the kasra.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿وإذا مس الإنسان ضر دعا ربه منيبا إليه﴾: the wāw: resumptive; (إذا): an adverb of future time, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative, containing the meaning of condition; (مس): past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa; (الإنسان): fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa; (ضر): fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma; the clause ﴿دعا﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; (ربه): mafʿūl bihi; (منيبا): a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of ﴿دعا﴾; (إليه): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿منيبا﴾; and the clause ﴿وإذا مس الإنسان...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿ثم إذا خوله نعمة منه نسي ما كان يدعو إليه من قبل﴾: (ثم): a conjunction of delay; (إذا): an adverb of future time containing the meaning of condition; (خوله): indeclinable (mabnī) past verb, the fāʿil (agent) is "He", and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (نعمة): its second object; (منه): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective of ﴿نعمة﴾; the clause ﴿خوله..﴾ is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; the clause ﴿نسي..﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; (نسي): past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو), referring to man; (ما): mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿كان﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. The noun of (كان) is latent, referring to man; the clause ﴿يدعو﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of (كان); (إليه): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يدعو﴾; and (من قبل): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وجعل لله أندادا ليضل عن سبيله﴾: (جعل): past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "he"; the clause ﴿جعل..﴾ is conjoined to ﴿نسي..﴾; (لله): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted [word] which is the second object of (جعل); (أندادًا): the first object of (جعل); (ليضل): the lām is for purpose (taʿlīl), and (يضل) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) «أن» after the lām; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from «أن» and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿جعل﴾; and (عن سبيله): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يضل﴾.
﴿قل تمتع بكفرك قليلا﴾: (قل): imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); (تمتع): imperative verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and the fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the speech (maqūl) of the saying; (بكفرك): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تمتع﴾; and (قليلا): standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an adjective of the maṣdar (verbal noun).
﴿إنك من أصحاب النار﴾: (إن): an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and the kāf is its noun; (من أصحاب): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of (إن); and (النار): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) by the kasra.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿أمن هو قانت آناء الليل ساجدا وقائما يحذر الآخرة ويرجو رحمة ربه﴾: (أم): connected (muttaṣila), and its counterpart is omitted, its implied form being ﴿آلكافر خير أم الذي هو قانت﴾ ("is the disbeliever better, or the one who is devoutly obedient?"); or disconnected (munqaṭiʿa), in which case it is rendered by «بل» and the interrogative hamza, the implied form being: "Rather, is the one who is devoutly obedient like others, or like the disbeliever to whom it is said: Enjoy your disbelief?"; (من): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and its khabar (predicate) is omitted; (هو): mubtadaʾ; (قانت): its khabar; and the clause ﴿هو قانت﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position. (آناء): an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قانت﴾; (الليل): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (ساجدًا): a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun of ﴿قانت﴾, accusative (manṣūb); (قائمًا): conjoined to ﴿ساجدا﴾, accusative; (يحذر): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil (agent) is "he"; (الآخرة): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative by the fatḥa; (ويرجو): the wāw: a conjunction, and (يرجو): imperfect verb, nominative by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the wāw, and the fāʿil is "he"; (رحمة): mafʿūl bihi, accusative by the fatḥa; (رب): muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ﴿يحذر الآخرة﴾ is in the position of the accusative as a second ḥāl from the pronoun of ﴿قانت﴾; and the clause ﴿يرجو رحمة ربه﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿يحذر الآخرة﴾.
﴿قل هل يستوي الذين يعلمون والذين لا يعلمون إنما يتذكر أولو الألباب﴾: (قل): imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn; (هل): an interrogative particle, indeclinable on the sukūn; (يستوي): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ; (الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent); (يعلمون): imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿يعلمون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), with no grammatical position. ﴿الذين لا يعلمون﴾: conjoined to ﴿الذين يعلمون﴾; (إنما): the restraining and restrained [particle] (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (يتذكر): imperfect verb, nominative; (أولو): fāʿil, nominative by the wāw; (الألباب): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) by the kasra; and the clause ﴿يتذكر أولو الألباب﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿قل يا عباد الذين آمنوا اتقوا ربكم﴾: (قل): imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); (يا): vocative particle; (عبادي): the one addressed (munādā), annexed, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ, which has been dropped for lightness; (الذين): an adjective of ﴿عبادي﴾, in the position of the accusative; the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿يا عباد...﴾ is the speech (maqūl) of the saying. (اتقوا): imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (رب): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; ﴿كم﴾: an indeclinable pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause ﴿اتقوا ...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position, and it is the answer to the vocative.
﴿للذين أحسنوا في هذه الدنيا حسنة وأرض الله واسعة﴾: (للذين): fronted khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿أحسنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿الذين﴾, with no grammatical position. (في هذه): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أحسنوا﴾; (الدنيا): a badal (substitute) from the demonstrative; (حسنة): postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); (أرض): mubtadaʾ, nominative, and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and (واسعة): khabar.
﴿إنما يوفى الصابرون أجرهم بغير حساب﴾: the clause gives the reason for what precedes; (إنما): the restraining and restrained [particle] (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (يوفى): imperfect verb, built for that whose agent is not named [i.e. passive], nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif; (الصابرون): nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative by the wāw; (أجرهم): second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (بغير): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿أجرهم﴾; and (حساب): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) by the kasra.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t: ﴿قل إني أمرت أن أعبد الله مخلصا له الدين﴾: (قل): imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); (إن): an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and the yāʾ is its noun; the clause ﴿أمرت﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of (إن); (أمرت): past verb, built for that whose agent is not named [i.e. passive], and the tāʾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (أن): a maṣdar-forming particle; (أعبد): imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa, and the fāʿil is "I" (أنا); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أن أعبد﴾ is accusative by removal of the preposition ﴿الباء﴾; (الله): the Name of Majesty, accusative by way of veneration (ʿalā al-taʿẓīm); (مخلصًا): a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of ﴿أعبد﴾, accusative; (له): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مخلصا﴾; (الدين): mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿مخلصا﴾; and the clause ﴿إني أمرت...﴾ is in the position of the accusative as the speech (maqūl) of the saying ﴿قل﴾.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t: ﴿وأمرت لأن أكون أول المسلمين﴾: the wāw: a conjunction; (أمرت): past verb, built for that whose agent is not named [i.e. passive], and the tāʾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿لأن﴾: the lām is for purpose (taʿlīl) and (أن) is maṣdar-forming; ﴿أكون﴾: a deficient imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by (أن), and its noun is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "I" (أنا); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أن أكون﴾ is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the lām and its genitive are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أمرت﴾, the implied form being: "and I have been commanded with what I have been commanded so that I may be the first of the Muslims". Or the lām in ﴿لأن أكون﴾ is connective (ṣila) [i.e. redundant], the evidence for this view being its occurrence without the lām in the words of the Exalted ﴿وأمرت أن أكون من المسلمين﴾, ﴿وأمرت أن أكون من المؤمنين﴾ and ﴿قل إني أمرت أن أكون أول من أسلم﴾. (أول): the khabar (predicate) of ﴿أكون﴾, accusative; (المسلمين): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive by the yāʾ, because it is a sound masculine plural; and the clause ﴿أمرت لأن أكون أول المسلمين﴾ is conjoined to ﴿أمرت أن أعبد الله...﴾.

muyesser-irab:64-64.t:
﴿قل أفغير الله تأمروني أعبد أيها الجاهلون﴾: قل: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, and the fāʿil (agent) is "أنت"; the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī); the fāʾ: linking (rābiṭa) to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition; غير: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of أعبد, accusative (manṣūb) with fatḥa; الله: the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); تأمروني: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, which is assimilated into the nūn of protection (nūn al-wiqāya), the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi and the wāw is fāʿil; أعبد: an imperfect verb, nominative with ḍamma, and the fāʿil is "أنا"; أيها: أي: the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), mabnī on ḍamma, and ها is for drawing attention (tanbīh); الجاهلون: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾, nominative with the wāw.
The clause ﴿قل...﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); the clause ﴿تأمروني﴾ is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if Allah is the Creator of everything"; and the clause ﴿أيها الجاهلون﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is resumptive.

muyesser-irab:65-65.t:
﴿ولقد أوحي إليك وإلى الذين من قبلك﴾: the wāw: resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); the lām falls in the answer of an implied oath; قد: a particle of verification (taḥqīq); أوحي: a past verb, passive, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa; إليك: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أوحي﴾; إلى الذين: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أوحي﴾; من قبلك: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿لئن أشركت ليحبطن عملك ولتكونن من الخاسرين﴾: the lām is the oath-preparing lām (al-lām al-muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam), again; إن: conditional; أشركت: a past verb, mabnī, in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent); the lām falls in the answer of the oath, and this oath and its answer are the answer of the first oath, while the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted; يحبطن: an imperfect verb, mabnī on fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis; عملك: fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿ولقد أوحي...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ولتكونن: the wāw: conjunctive, and the lām falls in the answer of the oath; the clause ﴿يحبطن..﴾ is in the answer of an oath, and the apodosis is omitted because the answer of the oath indicates it; تكونن: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, mabnī on fatḥa, the nūn being for emphasis, and its ism (noun) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "أنت"; ﴿من الخاسرين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of ﴿تكونن﴾; the clause ﴿إن أشركت ليحبطن﴾ is in the position of nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and the clause ﴿تكونن من الخاسرين﴾ is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to ﴿يحبطن..﴾.

muyesser-irab:66-66.t: ﴿بل الله فاعبد وكن من الشاكرين﴾: بل: a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction; الله: the Divine Name, accusative (manṣūb) by an omitted verb indicated by فاعبد; the fāʾ: the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; اعبد: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "أنت"; كن: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperative verb, mabnī on sukūn, and its ism (noun) is latent, its implied form being "أنت"; من الشاكرين: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of ﴿كن﴾; the clause ﴿اعبد..﴾ is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e. "if you are rational", or it is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to an implied resumptive clause, i.e. "take heed"; and the clause ﴿كن من الشاكرين﴾ is in the position of jussive, or it has no grammatical position, being conjoined to ﴿اعبد..﴾.

muyesser-irab:67-67.t:
﴿وما قدروا الله حق قدره﴾: the wāw: resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); ما: negating; قدروا: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); الله: the Divine Name, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); حق: standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is its attribute, the implied sense being: "they did not esteem Allah with His true esteem (قدرَه الحقَّ)"; قدره: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), and it is a muḍāf, and the hāʾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause ﴿ما قدروا..﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is resumptive.
﴿والأرض جميعا قبضته يوم القيامة والسماوات مطويات بيمينه﴾: the wāw: circumstantial (li-l-ḥāl); الأرض: mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ) with ḍamma; جميعًا: ḥāl (circumstantial) from الأرض, accusative; قبضته: khabar (predicate), nominative, and the hāʾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; يوم: an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān), accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl from قبضته; والسماوات: the wāw: conjunctive, and السماوات: mubtadaʾ, nominative with ḍamma; مطويات: khabar, nominative with ḍamma; بيمينه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿مطويات﴾; and the clause ﴿الأرض جميعا قبضته﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
﴿سبحانه وتعالى عما يشركون﴾: سبحانه: standing in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq, accusative by an omitted verb, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the wāw: conjunctive; تعالى: a past verb, mabnī on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif, and the fāʿil is "هو"; عما: عن: a preposition, and ما: a relative noun, mabnī on sukūn, in the position of genitive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿تعالى﴾; يشركون: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; and the clause ﴿يشركون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:68-68.t:
﴿ونفخ في الصور فصعق من في السماوات ومن في الأرض إلا من شاء الله﴾: the wāw: a conjunction, joining to what preceded; نفخ: a past verb, passive; في الصور: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نفخ﴾, and together they stand in the place of the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); فصعق: the fāʾ: conjunctive, and صعق: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa; من: a relative noun, mabnī on sukūn, in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent); في السماوات: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. The wāw: conjunctive; من: a relative noun, mabnī on sukūn, in the position of nominative, maʿṭūf (conjoined) to what precedes it; في الأرض: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila of ﴿من﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. إلا: a particle of exception; من: a relative noun, mabnī on sukūn, in the position of accusative as the excepted (mustathnā); شاء: a past verb, mabnī on fatḥa; الله: the Divine Name, fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ); the clause ﴿ونفخ في الصور﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); the clause ﴿شاء الله﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position. And the clause ﴿صعق من﴾ has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause ﴿نفخ في الصور﴾.
﴿ثم نفخ فيه أخرى فإذا هم قيام ينظرون﴾: ثم: a conjunction for sequence with delay; نفخ: a past verb, passive; فيه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نفخ﴾; أخرى: the nāʾib fāʿil of ﴿نفخ﴾, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif; the fāʾ: conjunctive; إذا: of surprise (fujāʾiyya), with no grammatical position; هم: a pronoun, mabnī, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); قيام: khabar (predicate), nominative; ينظرون: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿ينظرون﴾ is in the position of nominative as a second khabar; and the clauses ﴿نفخ فيه﴾ and ﴿وهم قيام﴾ are both conjoined to ﴿صعق من﴾.

muyesser-irab:69-69.t:
﴿وأشرقت الأرض بنور ربها ووضع الكتاب﴾: the wāw: conjunctive; أشرقت: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, and the tāʾ is for the feminine; الأرض: fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) with ḍamma; بنور: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أشرقت﴾; رب: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); ﴿ها﴾: a pronoun, mabnī, in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; وضع: a past verb, passive; الكتاب: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative; and ﴿أشرقت الأرض﴾ and ﴿وضع الكتاب﴾ are both maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause ﴿هم قيام﴾.
﴿وجيء بالنبيين والشهداء وقضي بينهم بالحق وهم لا يظلمون﴾: the wāw: conjunctive; جيء: a past verb, passive; بالنبيين: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted nāʾib fāʿil; الشهداء: conjoined to النبيين, genitive; the wāw: conjunctive; قضي: a past verb, passive; بينهم: an adverb of place (ẓarf makān), accusative (manṣūb), attached to ﴿قضي﴾, and ﴿هم﴾ is a pronoun, mabnī, in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; the nāʾib fāʿil is omitted, implied from the understood maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "and judgement was passed (وقضي القضاء)"; بالحق: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the wāw: circumstantial (ḥāliyya); هم: a detached pronoun, mabnī on sukūn, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); لا: negating; يظلمون: an imperfect verb, passive, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil; the clause ﴿لا يظلمون﴾ is in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate); and the clause ﴿هم لا يظلمون﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:70-70.t:
﴿ووفيت كل نفس ما عملت﴾: the wāw: conjunctive; وفيت: a past verb, passive, and the tāʾ is for the feminine; كل: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative (marfūʿ) with ḍamma; نفس: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); ما: a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿وفيت﴾; the clause ﴿عملت..﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; or ما is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya), and the interpreted maṣdar is the second object.
﴿وهو أعلم بما يفعلون﴾: the wāw: resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), or circumstantial (ḥāliyya); هو: a detached pronoun, mabnī on fatḥa, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); أعلم: khabar (predicate), nominative with ḍamma; بما: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أعلم﴾; يفعلون: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿وهو أعلم...﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is resumptive, or it is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); and the clause ﴿يفعلون﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative noun.

muyesser-irab:71-71.t:
﴿وسيق الذين كفروا إلى جهنم زمرا﴾: the wāw: conjunctive; سيق: a past verb, passive; الذين: a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); كفروا: a past verb, mabnī on ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; إلى جهنم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿سيق﴾; زمرا: ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿الذين﴾, accusative (manṣūb).
﴿حتى إذا جاءوها فتحت أبوابها﴾: حتى: inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya); إذا: an adverb of future time, mabnī on sukūn, in the position of accusative, containing the sense of condition; جاءوها: a past verb, mabnī on ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil, and ﴿ها﴾ is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿جاءوها﴾ is in the position of genitive by the adverb being annexed to it; فتحت: a past verb, passive, and the tāʾ is for the feminine; أبوابها: nāʾib fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ), and ﴿ها﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause ﴿فتحت أبوابها﴾ is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
﴿وقال لهم خزنتها﴾: the wāw: conjunctive; قال: a past verb, mabnī on fatḥa; لهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قال﴾; خزنتها: fāʿil, nominative with ḍamma, and ﴿ها﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿ألم يأتكم رسل منكم يتلون عليكم آيات ربكم﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of affirmation and disapproval (al-istifhām al-taqrīrī al-inkārī); لم: a particle of negation, inversion [of tense] and jussive; يأت: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم; the kāf: mafʿūl bihi; رسل: fāʿil, nominative with ḍamma; منكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted attribute (ṣifa) of ﴿رسل﴾; يتلون: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿يتلون..﴾ is a second attribute, or a ḥāl; عليكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يتلون﴾; آيات: the object of يتلون, accusative with kasra, because it is a sound feminine plural; رب: muḍāf ilayhi, and ﴿كم﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause ﴿ألم يأتكم رسل﴾ is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿وينذرونكم لقاء يومكم هذا﴾: the wāw: conjunctive; ينذرون: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil, and ﴿كم﴾ is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; لقاء: a second mafʿūl bihi, or accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ); يوم: muḍāf ilayhi, and ﴿كم﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; هذا: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿يومكم﴾, or a badal (substitute) from it, in the position of genitive; and the clause ﴿وينذرونكم..﴾ is in the position of accusative, maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause ﴿يتلون..﴾.
﴿قالوا بلى ولكن حقت كلمة العذاب على الكافرين﴾: قالوا: a past verb, mabnī on ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil; بلى: a particle of reply, for cancelling the negation and affirming that the messengers came and conveyed [the message]; the wāw: conjunctive; لكن: a particle of rectification (istidrāk); حقت: a past verb, mabnī on fatḥa, and the tāʾ is for the feminine; كلمة: fāʿil, nominative with ḍamma; العذاب: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; على الكافرين: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿حقت﴾; and the clause ﴿حقت كلمة العذاب﴾ is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:72-72.t:
﴿قيل ادخلوا أبواب جهنم خالدين فيها﴾: قيل: a past verb, passive; the clause ﴿قيل..﴾ is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), with no grammatical position; ادخلوا: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) [Translator's note: so in the source; ادخلوا is an imperative verb, mabnī on the dropping of the nūn]; the clause ﴿ادخلوا..﴾ is in the position of nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); أبواب: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) with fatḥa; جهنم: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) with fatḥa, because of being a proper name and feminine (a diptote); خالدين: ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative with the yāʾ, from the fāʿil of ﴿ادخلوا﴾; فيها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خالدين﴾.
﴿فبئس مثوى المتكبرين﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; بئس: a frozen (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame; مثوى: fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif; المتكبرين: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the yāʾ; the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, i.e. "it (هي)"; and the clause ﴿فبئس...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:73-73.t:
﴿وسيق الذين اتقوا ربهم إلى الجنة زمرا﴾: the wāw: conjunctive; سيق: a past verb, passive; الذين: a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); اتقوا: a past verb, mabnī on an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); رب: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) with fatḥa, and ﴿هم﴾ is a pronoun, mabnī, in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿اتقوا ربهم﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun ﴿الذين﴾; إلى الجنة: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿سيق﴾; زمرا: ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative.
﴿حتى إذا جاءوها وفتحت أبوابها﴾: حتى: inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya); إذا: an adverb of future time, mabnī on sukūn, in the position of accusative, containing the sense of condition; جاءوها: a past verb, mabnī, and the wāw is the fāʿil, and ﴿ها﴾ is mafʿūl bihi, in the position of accusative; the clause ﴿جاءوها﴾ is in the position of genitive by the adverb being annexed to it; its apodosis (jawāb) is omitted here, because it concerns the description of the people of Paradise; the wāw: conjunctive; فتحت: a past verb, passive, and the tāʾ is for the feminine; أبوابها: nāʾib fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ), and ﴿ها﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause ﴿فتحت أبوابها﴾ is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to ﴿جاءوها﴾.
﴿وقال لهم خزنتها سلام عليكم طبتم فادخلوها خالدين﴾: the wāw: conjunctive; قال: a past verb, mabnī on fatḥa; لهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قال﴾; خزنتها: fāʿil, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma, and ﴿ها﴾ is a pronoun, mabnī, in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; سلام: mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative with ḍamma; عليكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate); طبتم: a past verb, mabnī on sukūn, and the tāʾ is a pronoun, mabnī, in the position of nominative as fāʿil, and the mīm is for the plural; فادخلوها: the fāʾ: causal (taʿlīliyya); ادخلوها: an imperative verb, mabnī on the dropping of the nūn, the wāw is the fāʿil, and ﴿ها﴾ is mafʿūl bihi; خالدين: ḥāl, accusative with the yāʾ; the clause ﴿سلام عليكم﴾ is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); and the clause ﴿ادخلوها خالدين﴾ is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e. "if you enter it".

muyesser-irab:74-74.t:
﴿وقالوا الحمد لله الذي صدقنا وعده﴾: the wāw: conjunctive; قالوا: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); الحمد: mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ) with ḍamma; لله: the lām is a preposition and the Divine Name is a genitive noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of الحمد; the clause ﴿الحمد لله﴾ is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); الذي: a relative noun, mabnī on sukūn, in the position of genitive as a naʿt (adjective); صدقنا: a past verb, mabnī on fatḥa, and the fāʿil is "هو", and نا is in the position of accusative as the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); وعده: second mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause ﴿صَدَقَنا﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿وأورثنا الأرض نتبوأ من الجنة حيث نشاء فنعم أجر العاملين﴾: the wāw: conjunctive; أورثنا: a past verb, mabnī on fatḥa, and the fāʿil is "هو", and نا is in the position of accusative as the first mafʿūl bihi; الأرض: second mafʿūl bihi; نبتوأ [Translator's note: so in the source, a slip for نتبوأ]: an imperfect verb, nominative with ḍamma, and the fāʿil is "نحن"; من الجنة: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause ﴿نتبوأ..﴾ is a ḥāl from the object of أورثنا; حيث: an adverb of place (ẓarf makān), mabnī on ḍamma, in the position of accusative, attached to ﴿نتبوأ﴾; نشاء: an imperfect verb, nominative with ḍamma, and the fāʿil is "نحن"; the fāʾ: resumptive; نعم: a frozen (jāmid) past verb; أجر: the fāʿil of نعم, nominative with ḍamma; العاملين: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the yāʾ; the one specified for praise (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-madḥ) is omitted, i.e. "Paradise (الجنة)"; and the clause ﴿فنعم أجر العاملين﴾ is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:75-75.t:
﴿وترى الملائكة حافين من حول العرش يسبحون بحمد ربهم﴾: the wāw: resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); ترى: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif, and the fāʿil (agent) is "أنت"; الملائكة: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) with fatḥa; the clause ﴿وترى الملائكة﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; حافين: ḥāl (circumstantial) from الملائكة, accusative with the yāʾ; من حول: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿حافين﴾; العرش: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); يسبحون: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; بحمد: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl from the fāʿil of يسبحون; رب: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and ﴿هم﴾ is a pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. The clause ﴿يسبحون بحمد ربهم﴾ is in the position of accusative as a second ḥāl.
﴿وقضي بينهم بالحق وقيل الحمد لله رب العالمين﴾: the wāw: conjunctive; قضي: a past verb, passive; بين: an adverb of place (ẓarf makān), accusative, attached to ﴿قضي﴾, and ﴿هم﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; بالحق: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the wāw: conjunctive; قيل: a past verb, passive; الحمد: mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative with ḍamma; لله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate); رب: an attribute (ṣifa), genitive, of the Divine Name ﴿الله﴾; العالمين: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ in place of the kasra, because it is treated as (mulḥaq) a sound masculine plural; and the clause ﴿الحمد لله﴾ is in the position of nominative as nāʾib fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:13-13.t: ﴿قل إني أخاف إن عصيت ربي عذاب يوم عظيم﴾: (قل): imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); (إن): an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and the yāʾ is its noun; (أخاف): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "I" (أنا); the clause ﴿أخاف﴾ is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate); (إن): conditional; (عصيت): past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the tāʾ is the fāʿil; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "then I fear"; (عذاب): the object of ﴿أخاف﴾, accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa; (يوم): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) by the kasra; (عظيم): an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿يوم﴾, genitive.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t: ﴿قل الله أعبد مخلصا له ديني﴾: (قل): imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); the Name of Majesty (الله): a fronted object of ﴿أعبد﴾; (أعبد): imperfect verb, and its fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "I" (أنا); (مخلصًا): a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of ﴿أعبد﴾, accusative (manṣūb); (له): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مخلصا﴾; (ديني): mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿مخلصا﴾, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; the clause ﴿قل...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position, and the clause of the saying is in the position of the accusative as the speech (maqūl) of the saying.

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿فاعبدوا ما شئتم من دونه﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition); (اعبدوا): imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (ما): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (شئتم): past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, with its fāʿil; the clause ﴿شئتم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. (من دونه): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and the clause ﴿اعبدوا﴾ is in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition.
﴿قل إن الخاسرين الذين خسروا أنفسهم وأهليهم يوم القيامة﴾: (قل): imperative verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); (إن): an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); (الخاسرين): the noun of (إن), accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ; (الذين): its khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿خسروا..﴾ is the ṣila of (الذين), with no grammatical position. (أنفسهم): mafʿūl bihi, and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (أهليهم): maʿṭūf (conjoined) to ﴿أنفسهم﴾, accusative; (يوم): an adverb of time attached to ﴿خسروا﴾; (القيامة): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr).
﴿ألا ذلك هو الخسران المبين﴾: (ألا): a particle of alerting (tanbīh); (ذلك): mubtadaʾ (subject); (هو): a second mubtadaʾ; (الخسران): the khabar (predicate) of (هو); the clause ﴿هو الخسران﴾ is the khabar of (ذلك); (المبين): an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿الخسران﴾.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿لهم من فوقهم ظلل من النار ومن تحتهم ظلل﴾: (لهم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); (من فوقهم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); (ظلل): the delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); (من النار): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿ظلل﴾; and ﴿من تحتهم ظلل﴾ is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to ﴿من فوقهم ظلل﴾.
﴿ذلك يخوف الله به عباده يا عباد فاتقون﴾: (ذلك): mubtadaʾ; (يخوف): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the Name of Majesty (الله) is the fāʿil (agent); (به): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يخوف﴾; the clause ﴿يخوف الله به﴾ is the khabar of (ذلك); (عباده): the object of ﴿يخوف﴾, accusative (manṣūb); (يا): a vocative particle; (عباد): the one addressed (munādā), in construct with the yāʾ of the speaker, which is omitted following the script of the Muṣḥaf; the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition); (اتقون): imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, the wāw is the fāʿil, and the nūn is the nūn of protection (al-wiqāya), and the omitted yāʾ of the speaker is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿ذلك يخوف...﴾ is an explanatory resumptive (mustaʾnafa bayāniyyan), with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿يا عباد﴾ is in the position of the accusative as the speech (maqūl) of the saying; and the clause ﴿فاتقون﴾ is in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿والذين اجتنبوا الطاغوت أن يعبدوها وأنابوا إلى الله لهم البشرى﴾: the wāw: a conjunction; (الذين): mubtadaʾ (subject); (اجتنبوا): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (الطاغوت): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); the clause ﴿اجتنبوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), with no grammatical position. The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أن يعبدوها﴾ is a badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion) from ﴿الطاغوت﴾, accusative, i.e. "worshipping it"; (وأنابوا): the wāw is a conjunction, and (أنابوا) is a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (إلى الله): (إلى) is a preposition and the Name of Majesty is a genitive noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أنابوا﴾; (لهم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); (البشرى): the delayed mubtadaʾ; and the clause ﴿لهم البشرى﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of ﴿الذين﴾.
﴿فبشر عباد﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition); (بشر): imperative verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); (عباد): mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddara) on the letter before the yāʾ, which is omitted for lightness, and the omitted yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿الذين يستمعون القول فيتبعون أحسنه﴾: (الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿عباد﴾, or a badal (substitute) from it, or an explicative (bayān) of it; (يستمعون): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (القول): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). The clause ﴿يستمعون...﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The fāʾ: a conjunction. The clause ﴿يتبعون..﴾ is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause ﴿يستمعون..﴾. (أحسنه): mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿أولئك الذين هداهم الله وأولئك هم أولو الألباب﴾: (أولئك): mubtadaʾ (subject); (الذين): the khabar (predicate) of ﴿أولئك﴾; the clause ﴿هداهم الله﴾ is the ṣila of (الذين), with no grammatical position. (وأولئك): the wāw is a conjunction and (أولئك) is a mubtadaʾ; (هم): a second mubtadaʾ; (أولوا الألباب): the khabar of ﴿هم﴾ [Translator's note: the source writes «أولوا» here, while the Quranic text has ﴿أولو﴾]; the nominal clause is the khabar of ﴿أولئك﴾; the clause ﴿أولئك الذين هداهم الله﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; and the clause ﴿وأولئك هم أولو الألباب﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿أولئك الذين هداهم الله﴾.

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿أفمن حق عليه كلمة العذاب﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of denial (al-istifhām al-inkārī), and the fāʾ is a conjunction joining to something omitted indicated by the context, the implied form being: "Are you the one in charge of their affair, so that whoever the punishment has become due upon, you will rescue him?"; (من): conditional, or a relative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), with the khabar (predicate) omitted; (حق): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (عليه): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿حق﴾; (كلمة): fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma; (العذاب): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr).
﴿أفأنت تنقذ من في النار﴾: the second hamza is for interrogation, and the fāʾ is [the fāʾ] in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (أنت): mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿تنقذ﴾ is the khabar; (من): a relative noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (في النار): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, and the clause of the ṣila has no grammatical position. The clause ﴿من حق عليه كلمة العذاب﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is conjoined to an implied resumptive clause, i.e. "whoever disbelieved"; the clause ﴿حق عليه كلمة العذاب﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of ﴿من﴾; the clause ﴿أنت تنقذ...﴾ is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ, or it is resumptive with no grammatical position; and the answer [i.e. the khabar] of the relative is omitted, i.e. "like one who was saved"; and the clause ﴿تنقذ﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of ﴿أنت﴾.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t:
﴿لكن الذين اتقوا ربهم لهم غرف من فوقها غرف مبنية تجري من تحتها الأنهار﴾: (لكن): a particle of conjunction and digression (iḍrāb), in the sense of (بل), and not for rectification (istidrāk), because it is not preceded by a negation; (الذين): mubtadaʾ (subject); (اتقوا): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿اتقوا...﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), with no grammatical position. (رب): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (لهم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); (غرف): the delayed mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is the khabar of (الذين); (مبنية): an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿غرف﴾, nominative (marfūʿ); (تجري): imperfect verb, nominative by a ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the yāʾ; (من تحتها): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تجري﴾ or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿الأنهار﴾; (الأنهار): fāʿil, nominative by the ḍamma. The clause ﴿تجري من تحتها الأنهار﴾ is a second adjective. [Translator's note: the source does not parse ﴿من فوقها غرف﴾ in this entry.]
﴿وعد الله لا يخلف الله الميعاد﴾: (وعد): mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb; (الله): the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi; (لا): negating; (يخلف): imperfect verb, nominative; (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (الميعاد): mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb); the clause ﴿وعد الله﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the clause ﴿لا يخلف الله الميعاد﴾ is an explanatory resumptive (mustaʾnafa bayāniyyan), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:21-21.t:
﴿ألم تر أن الله أنزل من السماء ماء فسلكه ينابيع في الأرض﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; the hamza is for the interrogative of affirmation (al-istifhām al-taqrīrī); (لم): a particle of negation, conversion [to the past] and jussive; (تر): imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أن الله...﴾ stands in place of the two objects of ﴿تر﴾, or of its [single] object, since it is [a verb] of the heart [i.e. cognitive] or of sight; (أن): an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), the Name of Majesty ﴿الله﴾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿أنزل﴾ is its khabar (predicate); (أنزل): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and the fāʿil is "he"; (من السماء): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أنزل﴾; (ماء): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (فسلكه): the fāʾ is a conjunction, and (سلك) is a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, and its fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "he", referring to Allah the Exalted, and the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi; (ينابيع): the second mafʿūl bihi, by virtue of (سلكه) being made to include the meaning of (جعله) "he made it"; (في الأرض): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ينابيع﴾.
﴿ثم يخرج به زرعا مختلفا ألوانه﴾: (ثم): a conjunction; (يخرج): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil is "he"; (به): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يخرج﴾; (زرعًا): mafʿūl bihi; (مختلفًا): a naʿt of ﴿زرعًا﴾; (ألوانه): fāʿil of ﴿مختلف﴾.
﴿ثم يهيج فتراه مصفرا﴾: (ثم): a conjunction; (يهيج): imperfect verb, nominative; (فتراه): the fāʾ is a conjunction, and (تراه) is an imperfect verb, nominative by a ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the alif, the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "you" (أنت), and the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi; (مصفرا): the second mafʿūl bihi. The clause ﴿يهيج﴾ is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to ﴿ثم يخرج﴾.
﴿ثم يجعله حطاما إن في ذلك لذكرى لأولي الألباب﴾: (ثم): a conjunction; (يجعله): imperfect verb, nominative, the fāʿil is latent, and the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi; (حطامًا): the second mafʿūl bihi; (إن): an abrogating particle; (في ذلك): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); (ذكرى): its delayed noun; (لأولي): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿ذكرى﴾; (الألباب): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause ﴿يجعله...﴾ is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause ﴿أنزل...﴾.

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿أفمن شرح الله صدره للإسلام فهو على نور من ربه﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; the hamza is for the interrogative of denial (al-istifhām al-inkārī), and the fāʾ is a conjunction joining to an implied clause, i.e. "Are all people equal?"; (من): a relative noun or conditional, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); on the first [view] its khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "like one whose heart has been sealed", and on the second its khabar is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) and its apodosis (jawāb) together; (شرح): past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa; (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent); (صدره): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (للإسلام): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿شرح﴾; the fāʾ is a conjunction in either case; (هو): mubtadaʾ; (على نور): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar; (من ربه): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿نور﴾, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿فويل للقاسية قلوبهم من ذكر الله﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; (ويل): mubtadaʾ, it being permissible to begin with it [though indefinite] because of the meaning it carries of an imprecation of punishment and loss; (للقاسية): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar; (قلوبهم): fāʿil of (القاسية); (من ذكر): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿القاسية﴾, and it [i.e. من] is in the sense of (عن); (الله): the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause ﴿فويل للقاسية...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿أولئك في ضلال مبين﴾: (أولئك): mubtadaʾ; (في ضلال): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar; (مبين): an adjective of ﴿ضلال﴾; and the clause ﴿أولئك في ضلال مبين﴾ is an explanatory resumptive (mustaʾnafa bayāniyyan), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿الله نزل أحسن الحديث كتابا متشابها مثاني﴾: the Name of Majesty: mubtadaʾ (subject); (نزل): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and the fāʿil (agent) is "he"; (أحسن): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (الحديث): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); the clause ﴿نزل أحسن الحديث﴾ is the khabar (predicate); (كتابا): a badal (substitute) from ﴿أحسن الحديث﴾, accusative; (متشابهًا): a first naʿt (adjective) of ﴿كتابا﴾, accusative; (مثاني): a second naʿt, accusative; and the clause ﴿الله نزل...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿تقشعر منه جلود الذين يخشون ربهم ثم تلين جلودهم وقلوبهم إلى ذكر الله﴾: (تقشعر): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the clause ﴿تقشعر﴾ is a third naʿt; (منه): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تقشعر﴾; (جلود): fāʿil, nominative; (الذين): muḍāf ilayhi; (يخشون): imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (رب): mafʿūl bihi, and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi; (ثم): a conjunction denoting delay (tarākhī); (تلين): imperfect verb, nominative; (جلودهم): fāʿil, nominative, and ﴿هم﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; (قلوبهم): maʿṭūf (conjoined) to ﴿جلودهم﴾; (إلى ذكر): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تلين﴾; (الله): the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; and the clause ﴿تلين جلودهم﴾ is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to ﴿تقشعر منه جلود﴾, or has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause ﴿يخشون ربهم﴾.
﴿ذلك هدى الله يهدي به من يشاء﴾: (ذلك): mubtadaʾ; (هدى): khabar, or a badal from the demonstrative; (الله): the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi; (يهدي): imperfect verb, nominative by an implied (muqaddara) ḍamma, and the fāʿil is "he"; the clause ﴿يهدي﴾ is either a ḥāl (circumstantial) or a khabar; (به): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يهدي﴾; (من): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (يشاء): imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "he"; the clause ﴿يشاء..﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position. And the clause ﴿ذلك هدى الله﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ومن يضلل الله فما له من هاد﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (مَن): a jussive conditional noun, in the position of the accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi of ﴿يضلل﴾; (يضلل): the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), given a kasra because of the meeting of two sukūns; (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil; the fāʾ: [the fāʾ] in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (ما): negating; (له): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted fronted khabar of ﴿هاد﴾; (مِن): a connective (ṣila) [i.e. redundant] preposition; (هاد): the delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative in position, genitive by ﴿مِن﴾ in form; the clause ﴿ومن يضلل الله﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ذلك هدى الله﴾, and the clause ﴿ومن يضلل الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. [Translator's note: the source calls this clause both conjoined and resumptive; translated as written.]

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿أفمن يتقي بوجهه سوء العذاب يوم القيامة﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of denial (al-istifhām al-inkārī), and the fāʾ is a conjunction joining to an implied clause understood from the content of the context, i.e. "Are all people equal? Then is one who guards…"; (من): a relative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (يتقي): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied (muqaddara) ḍamma; the clause ﴿يتقي بوجهه﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position. (بوجهه): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يتقي﴾, and the pronoun is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (سوء): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (العذاب): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (يوم): an adverb attached to ﴿يتقي﴾; (القيامة): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; and the khabar (predicate) of (من) is omitted, its implied form being "like one who is safe from the punishment".
﴿وقيل للظالمين ذوقوا ما كنتم تكسبون﴾: the wāw is for the ḥāl (circumstantial); (قيل): past verb, built for that whose agent is not named [i.e. passive], and the clause ﴿قيل﴾ is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl. (للظالمين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قيل﴾; (ذوقوا): imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿ذوقوا﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of ﴿قيل﴾; (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (كنتم): (كان) is a deficient past verb (one of kāna and its sisters), and the tāʾ is its noun; (تكسبون): imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; and the clause ﴿تكسبون﴾ is in the position of the accusative as the khabar of ﴿كنتم﴾.

muyesser-irab:25-25.t: ﴿كذب الذين من قبلهم فأتاهم العذاب من حيث لا يشعرون﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; (كذب): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; (الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent); (من قبلهم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿الذين﴾, and the clause of the ṣila has no grammatical position. (هم): an indeclinable pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (فأتاهم): the fāʾ: a conjunction, and (أتاهم): past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddara) on the alif, and (هم) is in the position of the accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (العذاب): the delayed fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ); the clause ﴿فأتاهم العذاب﴾ is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to ﴿كذب الذين﴾; (من حيث): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أتاهم﴾; (لا): negating; (يشعرون): imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; and the clause ﴿لا يشعرون﴾ is in the position of the genitive by the adverb's being put in construct with it.

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿فأذاقهم الله الخزي في الحياة الدنيا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (أذاقهم): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and (هم) is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of the accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent); (الخزي): the second mafʿūl bihi; (في الحياة): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أذاقهم﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); (الدنيا): a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿الحياة﴾, genitive (majrūr).
﴿ولعذاب الآخرة أكبر لو كانوا يعلمون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām: the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ); (عذاب): mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); (الآخرة): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; (أكبر): khabar (predicate), nominative; (لو): conditional; (كانوا): a deficient past verb (one of kāna and its sisters), and the wāw is its noun; (يعلمون): imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿يعلمون﴾ is its khabar; the apodosis (jawāb) of (لو) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, and the object of (يعلمون) is also omitted, its implied form being "its punishment".

muyesser-irab:27-27.t:
﴿ولقد ضربنا للناس في هذا القرآن من كل مثل﴾: the wāw: resumptive; the lām: [the lām of] the answer to an omitted oath; (قد): a particle of verification (taḥqīq); (ضرب): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and ﴿نا﴾: an indeclinable pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿ضربنا﴾ is the answer to an implied oath, and the implied oath clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; (للناس): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ضربنا﴾ as a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), because (ضرب) is made to include the meaning of (جعل); (في): a preposition; (هذا): a demonstrative, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the genitive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿ضربنا﴾; (القرآن): a badal (substitute) or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition), genitive (majrūr); (من): a preposition; (كل): a genitive noun; (مثل): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of the first object of ﴿ضربنا﴾, i.e. "a parable being of every kind of parable"; and the clause ﴿ولقد ضربنا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿لعلهم يتذكرون﴾: (لعل): a particle of hope (tarajjī) that makes [its noun] accusative, and (هم) is its noun; (يتذكرون): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿يتذكرون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿لعل﴾; and the clause ﴿لعلهم يتذكرون﴾ is an explanatory resumptive (mustaʾnafa bayāniyyan) or causal (taʿlīliyya), and on both views it has no grammatical position.
